papers.full_text: Correction: Japanese-Language AI Agent System for Human Papillomavirus Vaccine Infoveillance and Public Communication: Development and Feasibility Evaluation In “Japanese-Language AI Agent System for Human Papillomavirus Vaccine Infoveillance and Public Communication: Development and Feasibility Evaluation”, we identified several items requiring correction. They are set out below in the order in which they appear in the article, providing the original published text and the corrected text. None of the corrections change any finding or conclusion of the article. First, in the author byline, the degree designations of three authors were incorrect. The byline originally read: Junyu Liu, PhD; Siwen Yang, BEng; Dexiu Ma, PhD; Qian Niu, PhD; Zequn Zhang, PhD; Momoko Nagai-Tanima, PhD; Tomoki Aoyama, MD, PhD The corrected byline now reads: Junyu Liu, ME; Siwen Yang, BEng; Dexiu Ma, MS; Qian Niu, PhD; Zequn Zhang, MS; Momoko Nagai-Tanima, PhD; Tomoki Aoyama, MD, PhD Second, in the section Report Generation Evaluation Methodology in the Methods section, the following text was corrected: Both protocols use LLM-based judges with standardized scoring rubrics, generating scores on a scale from 0 to 5 (Multimedia Appendices 4 and 5) for each dimension. The text now reads: Both protocols were applied by 3 domain experts using the standardized scoring rubrics provided in Multimedia Appendices 4 and 5, assigning scores on a scale from 0 to 5 for each dimension. Each expert scored every report section independently. This aligns the paragraph with the remainder of the same section (“Three volunteers read and scored each report independently”) and with the Results section (“Three evaluators independently scored each report section”), which are correct. The values reported in Table 5 and Multimedia Appendix 10 (included here as Multimedia Appendix 1) are the scores of these 3 raters. An automated large language model–based checker was also implemented and executed, but its output was not used for the values reported in this article. This correction does not affect the corresponding sentence in the section Chatbot Evaluation Methodology, where the chatbot evaluation was indeed performed by large language model–based judges, as stated. Third, in the Social Media Analysis subsection of the Methods, the stance classifier assigns one of three labels; no “unclear” label is produced. The sentence, which read: Stance classification categorizes each post as supportive, opposed, neutral, or unclear regarding HPV vaccination using batch LLM inference with a temporal context, thereby aggregating daily counts to track sentiment evolution. has been corrected to: Stance classification categorizes each post as supportive, opposed, or neutral regarding HPV vaccination using batch LLM inference with a temporal context, thereby aggregating daily counts to track sentiment evolution. The daily counts reported in the article were aggregated over the three labels the classifier assigns, so no reported value changes. In the same section, misinformation detection flags a post and records a short statement of the claim; it does not assign the post to a type. The sentence, which read: Misinformation detection uses LLM-based analysis to identify posts containing claims that contradict the established scientific consensus, categorizing detected content by type (safety concerns, efficacy doubts, and conspiracy theories) for institutional awareness. has been corrected to: Misinformation detection uses LLM-based analysis to identify posts containing claims that contradict the established scientific consensus, recording for each flagged post a short statement of the claim for institutional awareness. No counts by type are reported in the article, so no reported value changes. Fourth, the row for chat conversations in Table 1 described the set of conversations used for the chatbot evaluation, but the three values in the row were derived from three different populations. The row was published as: Collection Documents (n=139,803), n (%) Unique source Primary language Chat conversations 139 (0.10) 31 sessions Japanese (59.3%) The table row has been corrected to the following: Collection Documents (n=139,803), n (%) Unique source Primary language Chat conversations 139 (0.10) 37 sessions English (98.6%); Japanese (1.4%) The following footnote has been added to Table 1: The chat row describes the conversation set used for the chatbot evaluation: 139 turns, each stored as one document, from 37 conversations. Language proportions were computed over the 139 user messages in this set. Primary language for the Papers, Official documents and Social media rows was assigned on the basis of the source of each collection and was not derived from automated language detection. The other three rows of Table 1, the column percentages, and the total of 139,803 documents are unchanged. Specifically, the number of sessions has been corrected from 31 to 37. The 139 documents are the 139 single-turn question-answer exchanges reported in Table 2, which originate from 37 conversations (Multimedia Appendix 6). The figure of 31 is the number of conversations used for the multiturn evaluation reported in Table 3 (Multimedia Appendix 7), which comprise 133 turns. The language proportions have been corrected. Computed over the 139 user messages in this set, 137 (98.6%) are in English and 2 (1.4%) are in Japanese. The previously reported value of “Japanese (59.3%)” was derived from a different population and does not describe the 139 documents referred to in this row. Fifth, the multiturn evaluation block of Table 4 was published as: Check type and dimension Rater 1 Rater 2 Rater 3 MADa Spearman ρ (95% CI) ICCb(3,1) (95% CI) Multiturn evaluation (n=11 conversations) Context memory 0.13 0.13 0.13 0.13 — 1.000 (1.000 to 1.000) Topic centering 0 0.13 0 0.04 — 0.000 (−0.307 to 0.545) Identity 0 0.13 0.55 0.21 — 0.174 (−0.208 to 0.684) Table 4 has been corrected as follows: Check type and dimension Rater 1 Rater 2 Rater 3 MADa Spearman ρ (95% CI) ICCb(3,1) (95% CI) Multiturn evaluation (n=8 conversations) Context memory 0.13 0.13 0.13 0.13 — —e Topic centering 0 0.13 0 0.04 — 0.000 (−0.307 to 0.545) Identity 0 0.13 0.50 0.21 — 0.174 (−0.208 to 0.684) The new footnote e reads: e The 3 experts’ scores were all the same, and the ICC could not be calculated. All statistics in the multiturn block of Table 4 were computed over these 8 conversations; the header overstated the number. For the Context memory row, all 3 experts assigned a score of 5 to every conversation, so the between-item variance is zero and the intraclass correlation coefficient is undefined; the em dash follows the convention already used in the Spearman ρ column of the same table. The single-turn evaluation block of Table 4 is unchanged. Sixth, in the Results section, the following text was revised: n=20 for single-turn evaluation and n=11 for multiturn evaluation The text has been corrected to: n=20 question-answer pairs for single-turn evaluation and n=8 conversations for multiturn evaluation The corrected text also names the unit of each evaluation set. Seventh, in the Results section, the following sentence was corrected: Context memory showed perfect interrater reliability (ICC=1.000) as all 3 experts assigned identical scores, whereas topic centering (ICC=0.000) and identity (ICC=0.174) showed that the small deviations among raters did not follow consistent patterns—a consequence of near-ceiling score distributions. The text now reads: All 3 experts assigned identical scores to every conversation for context memory, whereas topic centering (ICC=0.000) and identity (ICC=0.174) showed that the small deviations among raters did not follow consistent patterns—a consequence of near-ceiling score distributions. This aligns the sentence with the correction to the ICC(3,1) column in item 5. Eighth, in the section Report Generation in the Results, the following text was corrected: Citation correctness was the most variable dimension (median 4.00, IQR 4.00‐5.00; mean 4.21, 95% CI 3.96‐4.46), with scores spanning the range of 4 to 5 The text now reads: Citation correctness was the most variable dimension (median 4.00, IQR 4.00‐5.00; mean 4.21, 95% CI 3.96‐4.46), with scores spanning the range of 3 to 5 Ninth, in Table 5, the rows for Helpfulness and Citation correctness originally read: Dimension Score (0‐5), mean (SD; 95% CI) Score (0‐5), median (IQR) Score of 5, % Score of ≥4, % Score of ≤3, % Helpfulness 4.12 (3.98‐4.27) 4.00 (4.00‐4.00) 19 94 0 Citation correctness 4.21 (3.96‐4.46) 4.00 (4.00‐5.00) 29 92 0 The rows have been corrected to the following: Dimension Score (0‐5), mean (SD; 95% CI) Score (0‐5), median (IQR) Score of 5, % Score of ≥4, % Score of ≤3, % Helpfulness 4.12 (3.98‐4.27) 4.00 (4.00‐4.00) 19 94 6 Citation correctness 4.21 (3.96‐4.46) 4.00 (4.00‐5.00) 29 92 8 The published values in the “Score of ≤3, %” column were inconsistent with the “Score of ≥4, %” column in the same rows. The corrected values correspond to 3 of the 48 helpfulness scores and 2 of the 24 citation correctness scores being 3 (3/48, 6%; 2/24, 8%). The other three rows of Table 5 are unchanged. Tenth, in the section Interpretation in the Discussion, the following sentence has been deleted: The higher agreement in multiturn evaluation, where full dialogue context is available (context memory ICC=1.000), supports this interpretation. Eleventh, in the section Limitations in the Discussion, the following text was revised: The evaluation dataset (31 conversations and 139 exchanges) may not capture all real-world interaction patterns This has been corrected to the following: The evaluation datasets (139 single-turn exchanges and 31 multiturn conversations) may not capture all real-world interaction patterns The two figures in the original text described different evaluation sets: the 139 exchanges are the single-turn evaluation items (Multimedia Appendix 6), whereas the 31 conversations are the multiturn evaluation set (Multimedia Appendix 7), which comprises 133 turns. As printed, the two figures could be read as the conversation and turn counts of a single set. Twelfth, in the Conclusions section of the Discussion, the following text was revised: The integrated architecture may enable bidirectional information flow—providing verified information with transparent source attribution to users while generating analytical reports for institutional stakeholders—creating feedback loops between public concerns and communication strategies. The text has been corrected to: The integrated architecture may enable bidirectional information flow—providing verified information with transparent source attribution to users while generating analytical reports for institutional stakeholders—creating links between public concerns and communication strategies. Only the term “feedback loops” has been changed. The term was used to refer to the circulation of information: conversations recorded with user consent become available to the report generation component so that public concerns can reach institutional readers. However, “feedback” also carries its control-theoretic sense, in which an output returns to the input and automatically adjusts the behavior of the system. The system implements no such loop: no path from the generated reports back to the conversational interface exists. Because the two senses can be confused, the term was not an appropriate choice. “Links” states the relationship without implying closure or automatic adjustment. No reported result is affected. Thirteenth, the authors have replaced Multimedia Appendix 10 (included here as Multimedia Appendix 1) with a new file. Three corrections have been made to it. In the table of reference evaluation results by section, the column headers “Completeness” and “Correctness” have been corrected to “Reference validity” and “Citation correctness,” respectively. The headers as published were those of the main text evaluation table above it; the columns contain reference validity and citation correctness scores. In the same table, the value for July 2020 / Paper / Citation correctness has been corrected from “4.00±0.00” to “4.00 ± 1.00.” The three expert scores for this cell were 3, 4, and 5. This is the only cell of that table whose value did not reproduce; the other 15 are unchanged. In the same table, the “Overall” values for Citation correctness have been corrected from “4.33±0.50” to “4.33±0.49” (News) and from “4.08±0.66” to “4.08±0.67” (Paper). The corresponding means are correct as published. The SDs in Multimedia Appendix 10 (included here as Multimedia Appendix 1) are sample SDs, consistent with the formulas in Multimedia Appendix 9 from which the table was produced. The following footnote has been added to both tables of the appendix file: Values are mean±sample standard deviation across the 3 evaluators, computed from the scores in Multimedia Appendix 9. The standard deviations reported in the Abstract are population standard deviations. None of these corrections affects the values reported in Table 5 or any finding of the study. Lastly, the Acknowledgments originally read: The authors used the generative artificial intelligence tool Claude [33] by Anthropic to refine the writing and structure of the manuscript, which was further reviewed and revised by the study group. The original Claude transcripts are available in Multimedia Appendix 11. This has been corrected to the following: The authors used the generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool Claude [33] by Anthropic to generate code, to assist with the analysis, to search the literature for references supporting statements in the manuscript, to retrieve reported figures from cited sources, and to refine the writing and structure of the manuscript. All AI-generated output was reviewed and revised by the study group. A record of part of these interactions is provided in Multimedia Appendix 11. The remaining interactions were not retained, so a complete transcript is not available. Two aspects of the original statement required correction. First, it described the use of the tool as limited to refining the writing and structure of the manuscript. The tool was in fact also used to generate code, to assist with the analysis, to search for literature supporting statements in the manuscript, and to retrieve figures from cited sources; the corrected text states this. Second, “the original Claude transcripts are available” could be read as indicating that the appendix contains the complete record. Multimedia Appendix 11 consists of 18 screenshots of part of these interactions; the remainder was not saved and cannot be supplied. The reported values do not depend on the correctness of any generated code: 280 reported values—those in Tables 1-5 and Multimedia Appendix 10 (included here as Multimedia Appendix 1), together with the associated statistics and bootstrap CIs reported in the text—have been independently recomputed from the saved evaluation data and the underlying document collections. Of these, 271 reproduce the values as published; the 9 that do not are precisely the numerical corrections in items 4, 5, 9, and 13 above. The CIs reproduce exactly under the random seed fixed in the analysis code. All coauthors have reviewed and approved these corrections and the replacement appendix file. We can provide their written agreement, a cell-level list of the changed appendix values, and the verification scripts and their output on request. The correction will appear in the online version of the paper on the JMIR Publications website together with the publication of this correction notice. Because this was made after submission to PubMed, PubMed Central, and other full-text repositories, the corrected article has also been resubmitted to those repositories. Supplementary material References Japanese-language AI agent system for human papillomavirus vaccine infoveillance and public communication: development and feasibility evaluation

papers.title_original: Correction: Japanese-Language AI Agent System for Human Papillomavirus Vaccine Infoveillance and Public Communication: Development and Feasibility Evaluation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of a Japanese-language AI agent system for HPV vaccine infoveillance and public communication, addressing the need for accurate and culturally relevant health information dissemination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and feasibility evaluation of an AI agent system for HPV vaccine-related infoveillance, with data collected from chat conversations and social media posts in Japanese and English, involving 139,803 unique documents.
analysis.methods: The system used a large language model (LLM) for stance classification, with three raters evaluating interrater reliability using metrics such as MAD, Spearman ρ, and ICC. The evaluation included single-turn and multiturn conversations, with results based on statistical analysis of scores across different dimensions.
analysis.main_results: The study corrected several errors, including the number of conversations used for multiturn evaluation (from 11 to 8), the language distribution of chat documents (from 59.3% Japanese to 1.4% Japanese), and inconsistencies in the “Score of ≤3, %” column of Table 5. The ICC for context memory was 1.000, indicating perfect interrater reliability, while topic centering and identity showed lower reliability.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the feasibility of the AI agent system for HPV vaccine infoveillance, with the correction of errors enhancing the accuracy of reported results and reliability metrics.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of AI tools for HPV vaccine communication and public health surveillance, highlighting the importance of accurate data representation and reliability in health-related infoveillance systems.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results were based on corrected data, which may affect the interpretation of reliability metrics. The evidence is moderate due to the focus on feasibility and the limited scope of the corrections.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a correction to a previous paper evaluating a Japanese-language AI agent system for HPV vaccine infoveillance and public communication. The corrections address errors in data reporting, including the number of conversations used for multiturn evaluation, language distribution of chat documents, and inconsistencies in score percentages. The study highlights the importance of accurate data representation and reliability in AI-based health communication tools. The findings suggest that the system is feasible for HPV vaccine-related infoveillance, with perfect interrater reliability for context memory but lower reliability for other dimensions. The evidence is moderate, as the corrections focus on data accuracy rather than comprehensive evaluation of the AI system's impact on public health outcomes. The study underscores the need for careful data handling in AI-driven health surveillance initiatives.

papers.title: Study on the molecular mechanism of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells inducing epithelial-mesenchymal transition in HPV-associated cervical cancer through activation of miR-129 .
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: HPV-associated cervical cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related death in women worldwide. The role of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and miR-129 in tumor progression remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: To investigate miR-129 expression and its clinical significance in HPV-associated cervical cancer and to explore whether BMSCs regulate malignant phenotypes through miR-129. METHODS: miR-129 expression was measured by qRT-PCR in 77 cervical cancer and 30 normal cervical tissues. Associations with clinicopathological features and overall survival (OS) were analyzed. Diagnostic value was assessed by ROC curve. Rat BMSCs were co-cultured with SiHa and HeLa cells. Following miR-129 overexpression or knockdown, cell proliferation (CCK-8, colony formation), invasion (Transwell) and expression of E-cadherin, N-cadherin and MRP1 (Western blot) were examined. papers.title: Hospitalization and mortality burden of human papillomavirus-associated cancers among men in Ecuador: a nationwide population-based study
papers.abstract: Introduction Human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated cancers in men contribute substantially to cancer-related morbidity and mortality, yet population-based evidence from Latin America remain limited, particularly in Ecuador. Materials and methods Using nationwide hospital discharge and mortality databases from Ecuador for 2015–2019, this retrospective secondary data analysis quantified the burden of HPV-associated cancers among men and estimated the HPV-attributable burden using published site-specific attributable fractions. Crude and age-specific rates were calculated, and age-standardized rates (ASRs) were obtained using the World Health Organization (WHO) World Standard Population. Results During 2015–2019, 3,442 hospitalizations due to HPV-associated cancers were recorded (ASR: 9.7 per 100,000 men), with head and neck cancers accounting for 66.4% of hospitalizations, followed by penile cancer (24.0%) and anal cancer (9.6%). Although hospitalization and mortality rates increased markedly with age, more than half of hospitalizations and approximately one-third of deaths from oropharyngeal, penile, and anal cancers occurred among men aged <60 years. Applying published site-specific attributable fractions, 1,002 hospitalizations were estimated to be HPV-attributable (ASR: 2.8 per 100,000 men), with penile cancer contributing the largest share. A total of 575 deaths due to HPV-associated cancers were identified (ASR: 1.7 per 100,000 men), of which 134 were estimated to be HPV-attributable (ASR: 0.4 per 100,000 men). Mortality rates increased progressively with age. Conclusion HPV-associated cancers impose a substantial hospitalization and mortality burden among men in Ecuador. Although the highest burden was observed among older adults, a considerable burden was also evident among men aged <60 years. These findings provide a national baseline for surveillance and may inform future evaluations of HPV prevention strategies, alongside efforts to achieve high and equitable HPV vaccination coverage, earlier diagnosis, timely treatment, and improved access to cancer care.

elements_zh.methods: 计算粗略比率和特定年龄比率,并使用世界卫生组织 (WHO) 世界标准人口获得年龄标准化比率 (ASR)。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果为 监测 提供了国家基线,并可能为未来 HPV 预防策略的评估提供信息,同时努力实现高且公平的 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率、早期 诊断、及时 治疗 以及改善获得癌症护理的机会。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到二手数据的使用和对已发表的特定地点归因分数的依赖的限制,这可能会引入偏差。证据强度中等。

Mortality rates increased progressively with age. Conclusion HPV-associated cancers impose a substantial hospitalization and mortality burden among men in Ecuador. Although the highest burden was observed among older adults, a considerable burden was also evident among men aged <60 years. papers.title: Prevalence, genotype distribution and associated factors of high-risk human papillomavirus among pregnant women in Eastern Ethiopia: a cross-sectional analysis nested within a population-based cohort study
papers.abstract: High-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection is the main cause of cervical precancer and cancer. Although Ethiopia introduced the quadrivalent Gardasil ® HPV vaccine (targeting HPV6, 11, 16, and 18), data on the distribution of HR-HPV genotype and the coverage provided by the vaccine remains limited. We assessed the prevalence, genotype distribution, theoretical vaccine coverage, and associated maternal factors for HR-HPV among apparently healthy pregnant women in eastern Ethiopia. This study was a cross-sectional analysis nested within the EthiOMICS cohort, a population based longitudinal study of pregnant women (12–22 weeks of gestation) recruited from the Hararghe Health and Demographic Surveillance System Site. A total of 217 vaginal swabs were collected, genomic DNA was extracted, and HR-HPV detection was performed using the Seegene HR HPV AllplexTM assay targeting 14 high-risk genotypes. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 28. Among the 217 pregnant women, HR-HPV prevalence was 12.9% (95% CI: 8.8–18.1). HPV16 and HPV66 were the most common genotypes (21.4% each), followed by HPV31, HPV58, and HPV51 (17.9% each); 35.7% of HPV-positive women harbored multiple HR-HPV genotypes. Participant-level theoretical genotype-based coverage among HR-HPV-positive women was 25.0% for the quadrivalent vaccine and 71.4% for the 9-valent vaccine. Detection of Ureaplasma parvum and Mycoplasma hominis was associated with HR-HPV in the adjusted exploratory analysis. More than one in eight pregnant women harbored HR-HPV, and more than one-third of these women had multiple high-risk genotypes. Theoretical participant-level genotype-based coverage of the quadrivalent vaccine currently used in Ethiopia was 25.0% among HR-HPV-positive women. These findings highlight the diversity of circulating HR-HPV genotypes among pregnant women in eastern Ethiopia and underscore the importance of continued molecular surveillance.

papers.abstract_zh: 高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染是宫颈癌前病变和宫颈癌的主要原因。尽管埃塞俄比亚推出了四价 Gardasil ® HPV 疫苗(针对 HPV6、11、16 和 18),但有关 HR-HPV 基因型分布和 疫苗 提供的覆盖范围的数据仍然有限。我们评估了埃塞俄比亚东部表面健康孕妇中 HR-HPV 的 患病率、基因型分布、理论 疫苗 覆盖率和相关母体因素。本研究是 EthiOMICS 队列研究 中的横断面分析,EthiOMICS 队列研究 是一项针对从 Hararghe 健康和人口统计 监测 系统站点招募的孕妇(妊娠 12-22 周)的基于人群的纵向研究。共采集217份阴道拭子,提取基因组DNA,并使用Seegene HR HPV AllplexTM检测针对14种高危基因型进行HR-HPV检测。使用 SPSS 28 版对数据进行分析。在 217 名孕妇中,HR-HPV 患病率 为 12.9%(95% CI:8.8–18.1)。HPV16 和 HPV66 是最常见的基因型(各 21.4%),其次是 HPV31、HPV58 和 HPV51(各 17.9%);35.7% HPV 阳性女性携带多种 HR-HPV 基因型。HR-HPV 阳性女性中四价 疫苗 的参与者水平基于理论基因型的覆盖率为 25.0%,9 价 疫苗 的覆盖率为 71.4%。在调整后的探索性分析中,微小解脲支原体和人型支原体的检测与 HR-HPV 相关。超过八分之一的孕妇携带 HR-HPV,其中超过三分之一的女性携带多种高危基因型。目前在埃塞俄比亚使用的四价 疫苗 在 HR-HPV 阳性女性中的理论参与者水平基于基因型的覆盖率为 25.0%。这些发现凸显了埃塞俄比亚东部孕妇中循环 HR-HPV 基因型的多样性,并强调了持续分子 监测 的重要性。

papers.title: Viral Intrusion: Unveiling the Role of Human Papillomavirus in Primary Lung Cancer – A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background : The role of human papillomavirus (HPV) in lung carcinogenesis remains debated. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the association between HPV infection and lung cancer risk and its potential prognostic implications. Methods: A systematic search of PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar (2015–2025) identified observational studies reporting HPV status in both lung cancer cases and non-cancer controls. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using a random-effects model. Heterogeneity was assessed with the I2 statistic, and publication bias was examined using funnel plot and Egger’s test. Studies lacking control groups or effect sizes were narratively summarized. Results: Nine studies (n = 3,871,842) were included in the meta-analysis, showing a pooled OR of 2.62 (95% CI: 1.86–3.68), indicating higher odds of lung cancer among HPV-infected individuals. Substantial heterogeneity was observed (I2 = 83.3%, p < 0.001) and publication bias was detected (Egger’s test p = 0.015). An additional 26 studies were narratively synthesized, many detecting HPV DNA mainly types 16 and 18 in lung tumors, particularly among non-smokers, females, and EGFR-mutated adenocarcinomas. Considerable variation in geographic origin, histology, detection method, and specimen type was also observed. Conclusion: HPV infection is significantly associated with an increased risk of lung cancer, suggesting its possible role as a risk and prognostic biomarker. However, the presence of publication bias and heterogeneity underscores the need for further large-scale, standardized studies to validate these findings.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the association between human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and lung cancer risk, as well as its potential prognostic implications. A comprehensive search of PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar (2015–2025) identified nine observational studies with a total sample size of 3,871,842 participants, which showed a pooled odds ratio of 2.62 (95% CI: 1.86–3.68) for lung cancer among HPV-infected individuals. The findings suggest that HPV infection may be a risk and prognostic biomarker for lung cancer, but the heterogeneity and publication bias highlight the need for further large-scale, standardized studies to confirm these associations. The review emphasizes the importance of understanding the role of HPV in lung carcinogenesis and its potential implications for diagnosis and treatment.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 在肺癌发生中的作用仍存在争议。这项系统回顾和荟萃分析评估了 HPV 感染与肺癌风险之间的关联及其潜在的预后影响。方法:对 PubMed、ScienceDirect 和 Google Scholar (2015-2025) 进行系统检索,确定了报告肺癌病例和非癌症对照中 HPV 状态的观察性研究。使用随机效应模型计算具有 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的合并比值比 (OR)。使用 I2 统计量评估异质性,并使用漏斗图和 Egger 检验检查发表偏倚。对缺乏对照组或效应大小的研究进行了叙述性总结。结果:荟萃分析纳入了 9 项研究(n = 3,871,842),显示汇总 OR 为 2.62(95% CI:1.86–3.68),表明 HPV 感染者患肺癌的几率较高。观察到显着的异质性(I2 = 83.3%,p < 0.001),并检测到发表偏倚(Egger 检验 p = 0.015)。另外还叙述性地综合了 26 项研究,其中许多研究检测肺部肿瘤中的 HPV DNA(主要是 16 型和 18 型),特别是在非吸烟者、女性和 EGFR 突变的腺癌中。还观察到地理起源、组织学、检测方法和标本类型的显着差异。结论:HPV 感染与肺癌风险增加显着相关,表明其可能作为风险和预后生物标志物。然而,发表偏倚和异质性的存在强调需要进一步进行大规模标准化研究来验证这些发现。

papers.full_text: Abstract To establish outcomes of Human Papillomavirus-Related Multiphenotypic Sinonasal Carcinoma and evaluate indications for adjuvant treatment after resection to determine optimal management of such tumors. The databases searched were PubMed, Embase, Ovid (MEDLINE), and Cochrane for articles up to June 19, 2026. A systematic review was conducted. PubMed, Embase, and Ovid (MEDLINE) databases were searched, utilizing keywords such as “Paranasal Sinus Neoplasms” and “Papillomavirus infections”. Reference lists were searched for identification of relevant studies. Case reports, case series, literature reviews, and surgical reports were included. Thirty-one articles were eventually analyzed, with a total of a hundred-and-nineteen HMSC cases reported. The most common treatment prescribed was endoscopic resection. Adjuvant treatment post-surgical resection was administered at similar rates for patients regardless of HMSC staging. The majority of cases were clinically found to have no evidence of disease during their last follow-up, with only 5 cases of mortality due to HMSC reported in the cases that met inclusion criteria. Despite high-grade histological features, HMSC outcomes following definitive treatment are favorable. Endoscopic surgery remains the mainstay of treatment. Without clear guidelines outlining indications for adjuvant treatment, administration was based on the presence of high-risk clinical features. However, the long-term role of adjuvant treatment in reducing recurrence rates has yet to be discussed. Decisions should be individualized based on margins, invasion, and patient factors. papers.title_original: Human Papillomavirus-Related Multiphenotypic Sinonasal Carcinoma: A Systematic Review

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on Human Papillomavirus-Related Multiphenotypic Sinonasal Carcinoma (HMSC) and evaluates the outcomes of such tumors, as well as indications for adjuvant treatment after resection to determine optimal management strategies. The central question is about the clinical behavior and treatment approaches for HMSC.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review searched PubMed, Embase, and Ovid (MEDLINE) databases using keywords like 'Paranasal Sinus Neoplasms' and 'Papillomavirus infections'. It included case reports, case series, literature reviews, and surgical reports. A total of 31 articles were analyzed, with 119 HMSC cases reported.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The majority of HMSC cases showed no evidence of disease during their last follow-up. Endoscopic surgery remains the mainstay of treatment, and adjuvant treatment post-surgical resection was administered at similar rates regardless of HMSC staging. Despite high-grade histological features, outcomes following definitive treatment are favorable.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The long-term role of adjuvant treatment in reducing recurrence rates has not been discussed. There is no clear guidance on indications for adjuvant treatment, and decisions are based on the presence of high-risk clinical features. The review also notes that the evidence is limited and requires further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: There is a need for clear guidelines on adjuvant treatment indications for HMSC. Further research is required to understand the long-term role of adjuvant treatment in reducing recurrence rates. Individualized treatment decisions should be based on margins, invasion, and patient factors.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates Human Papillomavirus-Related Multiphenotypic Sinonasal Carcinoma (HMSC), focusing on clinical outcomes and treatment approaches. The review analyzed 31 articles reporting 119 HMSC cases, with endoscopic resection being the primary treatment. Most cases showed no evidence of disease at follow-up, and adjuvant treatment was used similarly across staging groups. Despite high-grade histology, outcomes were favorable. However, the long-term role of adjuvant treatment in reducing recurrence remains unclear. The review highlights the need for individualized treatment decisions and further research to establish guidelines for adjuvant therapy. The findings emphasize the importance of considering patient-specific factors and high-risk clinical features in management strategies.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注 人乳头瘤病毒 相关的多表型鼻窦癌 (HMSC),并评估此类肿瘤的结果,以及切除后辅助 治疗 的适应症,以确定最佳治疗策略。核心问题是关于 HMSC 的临床行为和 治疗 方法。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述使用“鼻旁窦肿瘤”和“乳头瘤病毒感染”等关键词搜索了 PubMed、Embase 和 Ovid (MEDLINE) 数据库。它包括 病例报告、病例系列、文献综述和手术报告。总共分析了 31 篇文章,报告了 119 例 HMSC 病例。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 大多数 HMSC 病例在最后一次随访期间没有表现出疾病证据。内窥镜手术仍然是 治疗 的支柱,无论 HMSC 分期如何,辅助 治疗 术后切除的比例相似。尽管具有高级组织学特征,但明确的 治疗 后的结果是有利的。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 佐剂 治疗 在降低复发率方面的长期作用尚未讨论。对于辅助 治疗 的适应症没有明确的指导,决策基于是否存在高风险临床特征。审查还指出,证据有限,需要进一步调查。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要关于 HMSC 辅助 治疗 适应症的明确指南。需要进一步的研究来了解佐剂 治疗 在降低复发率方面的长期作用。个体化的 治疗 决策应基于切缘、侵袭和患者因素。

papers.title: How do intertemporal preference and social signals drive parental choices? a discrete choice experiment on human papillomavirus vaccination
papers.abstract: Parental vaccine hesitancy constrains human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination uptake. However, how intertemporal preferences and social signals relate to this hesitancy remains underexplored. An online survey integrating a discrete choice experiment (DCE) and an intertemporal choice task was deployed to quantify attribute preferences, monetary discount rates, and the factors shaping parental decisions. Primary attribute preferences were estimated using a mixed logit model, while latent class analysis identified preference heterogeneity. Additionally, interaction terms were utilized to examine how intertemporal preferences modulate these choices. Empirical data reveal that protection duration and vaccine effectiveness were the primary determinants of parental choice, while social-reference information indicating that healthcare professionals’ children had been vaccinated was also valued. Vaccine origin showed no significant effect. Latent class analysis segmented the cohort into a receptive majority (79.4%) and a hesitant minority (20.6%). Interaction models indicated that monetary discounting was jointly associated with the structure of preferences, although no individual attribute interaction survived adjustment for multiple testing. Parental choices about HPV vaccination reflected clinical attributes, social reference information, and intertemporal preferences. Protection duration and vaccine effectiveness mattered most, and parents more often chose vaccination when told that healthcare professionals’ children had been vaccinated. Higher monetary discount rates were associated with membership in the receptive majority, although the attribute-level interactions were exploratory after adjustment for multiple testing. Reducing out-of-pocket costs and communicating credible social-reference information are worth testing as intervention strategies. Given the predominantly urban and highly educated sample, these findings should be generalized with caution.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study highlights the critical role of oral health professionals in preventing human papillomavirus (HPV) infections and associated diseases, emphasizing the need for increased awareness and proactive measures in this field.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial in the International Dental Journal, published on 2026-12-01, focusing on the responsibilities of oral health professionals in HPV prevention.
analysis.methods: The editorial outlines the importance of integrating HPV prevention strategies into routine dental care, including education, screening, and collaboration with other healthcare providers.
analysis.main_results: The editorial reports that oral health professionals have a unique opportunity to contribute to HPV prevention through early detection and patient education, though no specific numerical results are provided.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the integration of HPV prevention into dental practice is a novel approach to reducing the incidence of HPV-related diseases, particularly in populations where oral health professionals are the primary point of contact.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that oral health professionals can play a pivotal role in HPV surveillance and prevention, which has significant implications for public health strategies aimed at reducing the burden of HPV-associated cancers and infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As an editorial, the study does not present original data, and its conclusions are based on existing literature and expert opinion, which limits the strength of the evidence to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This editorial emphasizes the urgent need for oral health professionals to be actively involved in the prevention of human papillomavirus (HPV) infections and associated diseases. papers.title: Patterns, distributions and predictors of human papillomavirus vaccination coverage among girls across 31 African countries
papers.abstract: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women in sub-Saharan Africa, with Africa accounting for approximately 23% of global cervical cancer mortality. Despite the proven efficacy of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines in the prevention of cervical cancer, coverage remains far below the 90% global target. This study assessed HPV vaccination trends, regional differences, and the effect of vaccination programme duration on HPV vaccination coverage among girls and young women in Africa. Country data on HPV immunisation were obtained from the World Health Organization Immunization Portal. Descriptive statistics were used to estimate mean coverage (standard deviation), variation, and regional distribution in percentages. Linear regression analyses examined the association of HPV immunisation programme duration with vaccination coverage. By 2024, only 31 of 54 (56%) African countries had integrated HPV vaccination into their routine immunisation schedules, mostly targeting girls aged 9–14 years. The mean first-dose and last-dose coverage across the 31 countries were 64% (SD: 25.4) and 55% (SD: 27.3) respectively. The lowest coverage rates for the first and last doses were in Mali (15%), Gambia (15%) and Morocco (3%), whereas Cape Verde, Burkina Faso, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania, and Mauritius achieved over 90% for both doses. Regionally, first and last-dose coverage were 77% and 61% in Eastern and Southern Africa, 63% and 60% in West and Central Africa, and 52% and 27% in North Africa, respectively. Across the 31 countries, HPV immunisation programme duration was positively associated with first-dose coverage (coefficient = 2.97, 95% CI: 0.28–5.66, p = 0.032), with each additional year of the programme associated with a 3% increase in vaccination coverage. In 2022, second-dose coverage was significantly associated with both programme duration (β = 4.192, SE = 1.278, 95% CI: 1.53–6.85, p = 0.004) and first-dose vaccination coverage (β = 0.321, SE = 0.133, 95% CI: 0.04–0.59, p = 0.025). HPV vaccination coverage in Africa is increasing slowly but remains below the target. However, longer programme duration is associated with higher uptake, highlighting the need for sustained investment and strengthened programme delivery to meet global vaccination targets.

papers.title: Is Endocervical Curettage (ECC) Necessary for All HPV16/18-Positive Patients? A Stratified Analysis of 670 Cases
papers.abstract: Background: High-risk HPV16/18 subtypes account for over 70% of cervical cancers, but should all HPV16/18-positive patients routinely undergo endocervical curettage (ECC)? Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on 670 HPV16/18-positive patients who underwent colposcopy at Peking University People’s Hospital from 2021 to 2024. Stratified analysis was performed based on prior HPV infection history, current cervical cytology and HPV test results, transformation zone (TZ) type, and colposcopic impression. Primary outcome was the detection rate of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia above (CIN2)+ on final pathology and the additional diagnostic yield of ECC in the ECC subgroup. Results: Among the 670 HPV16/18-positive women, CIN2+ was identified in 32.5% (218/670); the CIN2+ group was significantly younger than the < CIN2 group (median 36.5 vs. 41.0 years, p < 0.001). A high-grade colposcopic impression (G2) steeply elevated the observed CIN2+ proportion to 100%, especially combined with high-grade cytology. In contrast, a Normal/G1 colposcopic finding effectively downgraded the risk to 4.8% in the presence of prior HPV negativity + low-grade cytology + visible TZ. Among the 523 ECC specimens, it is noteworthy that even when the final pathology was diagnosed as CIN2+, a considerably high proportion of patients (44.4–64.7%) remained free of lesions in the endocervical canal; in the colposcopy impression (G2) population, 68.1% of the ECC was normal. The incremental yield of ECC over directed biopsy was only 2.7% (14/523), and all 14 incremental cases occurred in TZ3 (100%). Among the 146 women meeting the composite low-risk profile (TZ1/2 combined with a Normal/G1 colposcopic impression), none had an incremental CIN2+ detection. Conclusion: Women with HPV16/18-positive CIN2+ lesions presented at a younger age. Approximately one-third were diagnosed with CIN2+, and more than half of these had normal ECC histology. With a low additional diagnostic rate observed, ECC provided incremental diagnostic benefit in only 2.7% of HPV16/18-positive women undergoing colposcopy, almost exclusively among patients with a Type 3 transformation zone. The composite low-risk profile identified a subgroup with an extremely low additional diagnostic yield of ECC; however, prospective validation is required before the omission of ECC in this subgroup can be recommended as a change in clinical practice.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether endocervical curettage (ECC) is necessary for all HPV16/18-positive patients. A retrospective cohort of 670 patients underwent colposcopy at Peking University People’s Hospital between 2021 and 2024. Stratified analysis revealed that CIN2+ was detected in 32.5% of patients, with younger age associated with higher detection rates. analysis_zh.main_results: 在 670 名 HPV16/18 阳性女性中,CIN2+ 占 32.5% (218/670);CIN2+ 组明显比 < CIN2 组年轻(中位年龄 36.5 岁 vs. 41.0 岁,p < 0.001)。相比之下,在既往 HPV 阴性 + 低级别细胞学检查 + 可见 TZ 的情况下,正常/G1 阴道镜检查结果有效地将风险降低至 4.8%。ECC相对于定向活检的增量产率仅为2.7%(14/523),并且所有14个增量病例都发生在TZ3(100%)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 患有 HPV16/18 阳性 CIN2+ 病变的女性发病年龄较轻。大约三分之一被诊断为 CIN2+,其中一半以上具有正常的 ECC 组织学。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 由于观察到的附加诊断率较低,ECC 仅对 2.7% 接受阴道镜检查的 HPV16/18 阳性女性提供了增量诊断益处,几乎全部针对具有 3 型转化区的患者。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 综合低风险概况确定了 ECC 附加诊断率极低的亚组;然而,在建议在该亚组中省略 ECC 作为临床实践的改变之前,需要进行前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Therapeutic HPV16 E7 vaccination with CD137 agonism induces tumor regression and durable immunity in mice
papers.abstract: Prophylactic human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines prevent new infections but do not treat established HPV-associated lesions, highlighting the need for therapeutic strategies targeting viral tumor antigens. We developed a recombinant overlapping peptide-based HPV16 E7 vaccine (ROP-E7) and evaluated its immunogenicity and antitumor activity, alone or combined with CD137 (4-1BB) agonism, in C57BL/6 mice. In tumor-free mice, ROP-E7 induced greater helper and cytotoxic T cell responses than wild-type E7. In tumor-bearing mice, ROP-E7 reduced tumor burden and improved survival, while combination treatment induced complete tumor regression and tumor-free survival beyond 100 days. These effects were associated with increased intratumoral cytotoxic T cells and reduced regulatory and exhausted T cell populations. These findings provide preclinical support for combining therapeutic HPV16 E7 vaccination with T cell co-stimulation in HPV-associated cancers.

papers.title_zh: 具有 CD137 激动作用的治疗性 HPV16 E7 疫苗接种 可诱导小鼠肿瘤消退和持久免疫力
papers.source_body_en: Prophylactic human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines prevent new infections but do not treat established HPV-associated lesions, highlighting the need for therapeutic strategies targeting viral tumor antigens. We developed a recombinant overlapping peptide-based HPV16 E7 vaccine (ROP-E7) and evaluated its immunogenicity and antitumor activity, alone or combined with CD137 (4-1BB) agonism, in C57BL/6 mice. In tumor-free mice, ROP-E7 induced greater helper and cytotoxic T cell responses than wild-type E7. In tumor-bearing mice, ROP-E7 reduced tumor burden and improved survival, while combination treatment induced complete tumor regression and tumor-free survival beyond 100 days. These effects were associated with increased intratumoral cytotoxic T cells and reduced regulatory and exhausted T cell populations. These findings provide preclinical support for combining therapeutic HPV16 E7 vaccination with T cell co-stimulation in HPV-associated cancers.

papers.title: Silencing of E6/E7 proteins of HPV-16 in the CaCx cell line upregulate the expression of POTE-Paralogs
papers.abstract: POTE proteins are known to be expressed in tissues such as normal prostate, placenta, ovary, testis, and embryo, and are collectively referred to as POTE-family proteins based on this organ-specific expression. The POTE gene spans 32 kb on chromosome 21q11.2, although its homologous genes are distributed across eight different chromosomes. POTEE, as a member of the POTE family, has been identified as a Cancer Germline Antigen (CGA) across several cancer types including Colorectal, Pancreatic, Breast, Liver, and Lung cancers. This study aims to elucidate the role of POTE-Paralogs (POTEE & POTEF) as CGA markers in Cervical Cancer (CaCx). Over 90% of CaCx cases are associated with persistent infection by high-risk HPV (HR-HPV); the E6 and E7 oncoproteins of HPV contribute to carcinogenesis through the degradation or inactivation of tumor suppressor proteins p53 and pRB, leading to uncontrolled cell proliferation. Consequently, HPV-positive cervical cancer cell lines HeLa and CaSki lack detectable expression of p53, and the expression of POTE-Paralogs is also markedly decreased, while the HPV-negative CaCx cell line C-33A exhibits high p53 expression correlated with marked upregulation of POTE-Paralogs. Treatment of C-33A cells with a p53-specific inhibitor reduced POTE-Paralogs expression. Conversely, restoring p53 expression in CaSki cells with the chemotherapeutic agent Doxorubicin resulted in increased expression of POTE-Paralogs. Furthermore, silencing of E6/E7 in CaSki cells led to restoration of both p53 and pRB expression, as well as an increase in POTEE & POTEF levels. [BMB Reports 2026; 59(10): 466-473].

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study investigates the role of POTE-Paralogs as Cancer Germline Antigen (CGA) markers in Cervical Cancer (CaCx) and explores their expression patterns in relation to HPV infection. The background highlights the organ-specific expression of POTE-family proteins and their potential relevance to cancer biology.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study examines HPV-positive cervical cancer cell lines HeLa and CaSki, as well as the HPV-negative CaCx cell line C-33A. It compares the expression levels of POTE-Paralogs in these cell lines to understand their association with HPV infection and carcinogenesis.
analysis.methods: The study uses molecular techniques to silence E6/E7 proteins in CaSki cells and assesses the resulting changes in p53, pRB, and POTE-Paralogs expression. It also employs chemotherapeutic agents like Doxorubicin to restore p53 expression and evaluates the impact on POTE-Paralogs levels.
analysis.main_results: HPV-positive cervical cancer cell lines HeLa and CaSki show markedly decreased expression of POTE-Paralogs, while the HPV-negative cell line C-33A exhibits high p53 expression correlated with upregulated POTE-Paralogs. Silencing of E6/E7 in CaSki cells restored p53 and pRB expression, along with increased POTEE and POTEF levels.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the expression of POTE-Paralogs is inversely related to HPV infection and the activity of its oncoproteins E6 and E7. This study provides novel insights into the molecular mechanisms linking HPV infection to the downregulation of POTE-Paralogs in cervical cancer.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results may inform the development of diagnostic markers for HPV-associated cervical cancer and contribute to understanding the role of POTE-Paralogs in tumor suppression. They also highlight potential therapeutic targets related to p53 restoration in HPV-positive cancers.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro cell lines and does not account for in vivo conditions or clinical outcomes. However, the evidence is strong based on direct molecular observations and correlations with HPV infection status.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the expression of POTE-Paralogs in relation to HPV infection in cervical cancer cell lines. It finds that HPV-positive cell lines exhibit reduced POTE-Paralogs expression, while HPV-negative lines show increased levels. Silencing of E6/E7 proteins in HPV-positive cells restores POTE-Paralogs expression, suggesting a link between HPV oncoproteins and their downregulation. The results provide novel insights into the molecular mechanisms of HPV-associated carcinogenesis and highlight potential diagnostic and therapeutic implications. However, the study is limited to in vitro models and does not account for clinical outcomes, which may affect the generalizability of findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究调查了 POTE-Paralogs 作为癌症种系抗原 (CGA) 标记物在 宫颈癌 (CaCx) 中的作用,并探讨了它们与 HPV 感染相关的表达模式。背景强调了 POTE 家族蛋白的器官特异性表达及其与癌症生物学的潜在相关性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检测了 HPV 阳性 宫颈癌 细胞系 HeLa 和 CaSki,以及 HPV 阴性 CaCx 细胞系 C-33A。它比较了这些细胞系中 POTE-Paralogs 的表达水平,以了解它们与 HPV 感染和癌发生的关系。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用分子技术沉默 CaSki 细胞中的 E6/E7 蛋白,并评估由此产生的 p53、pRB 和 POTE-Paralogs 表达的变化。它还使用阿霉素等化疗药物来恢复 p53 表达并评估对 POTE-Paralogs 水平的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: HPV 阳性 宫颈癌 细胞系 HeLa 和 CaSki 显示 POTE-Paralogs 表达显着降低,而 HPV 阴性细胞系 C-33A 表现出与 POTE-Paralogs 上调相关的高 p53 表达。CaSki 细胞中 E6/E7 的沉默恢复了 p53 和 pRB 的表达,同时 POTEE 和 POTEF 水平增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,POTE-Paralogs 的表达与 HPV 感染及其癌蛋白 E6 和 E7 的活性呈负相关。这项研究为 HPV 感染与 宫颈癌 中 POTE-Paralogs 下调之间的分子机制提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能为 HPV 相关 宫颈癌 诊断标记的开发提供信息,并有助于了解 POTE-Paralogs 在肿瘤抑制中的作用。他们还强调了与 HPV 阳性癌症中 p53 恢复相关的潜在治疗靶点。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外细胞系,不考虑体内条件或临床结果。然而,基于直接分子观察以及与 HPV 感染状态的相关性,证据确凿。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究调查了 POTE-Paralogs 作为癌症种系抗原 (CGA) 标记物在 宫颈癌 (CaCx) 中的作用,并探讨了它们与 HPV 感染相关的表达模式。背景强调了 POTE 家族蛋白的器官特异性表达及其与癌症生物学的潜在相关性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究检测了 HPV 阳性 宫颈癌 细胞系 HeLa 和 CaSki,以及 HPV 阴性 CaCx 细胞系 C-33A。它比较了这些细胞系中 POTE-Paralogs 的表达水平,以了解它们与 HPV 感染和癌发生的关系。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用分子技术沉默 CaSki 细胞中的 E6/E7 蛋白,并评估由此产生的 p53、pRB 和 POTE-Paralogs 表达的变化。它还使用阿霉素等化疗药物来恢复 p53 表达并评估对 POTE-Paralogs 水平的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: HPV 阳性 宫颈癌 细胞系 HeLa 和 CaSki 显示 POTE-Paralogs 表达显着降低,而 HPV 阴性细胞系 C-33A 表现出与 POTE-Paralogs 上调相关的高 p53 表达。CaSki 细胞中 E6/E7 的沉默恢复了 p53 和 pRB 的表达,同时 POTEE 和 POTEF 水平增加。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,POTE-Paralogs 的表达与 HPV 感染及其癌蛋白 E6 和 E7 的活性呈负相关。这项研究为 HPV 感染与 宫颈癌 中 POTE-Paralogs 下调之间的分子机制提供了新的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可能为 HPV 相关 宫颈癌 诊断标记的开发提供信息,并有助于了解 POTE-Paralogs 在肿瘤抑制中的作用。他们还强调了与 HPV 阳性癌症中 p53 恢复相关的潜在治疗靶点。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外细胞系,不考虑体内条件或临床结果。然而,基于直接分子观察以及与 HPV 感染状态的相关性,证据确凿。

papers.title: Epidemiological characteristics and genotype distribution of human papillomavirus infection among 39,335 women in Gaochun District, Nanjing, China
papers.abstract: To characterize HPV positivity, age-specific distribution, infection patterns, genotype distribution, and annual variations in HPV positivity among women undergoing HPV testing at a hospital in Gaochun District, Nanjing, China, and to provide local baseline data for regional HPV surveillance and cervical cancer prevention and control research. This single-center retrospective cross-sectional study included women who underwent HPV testing at Gaochun People’s Hospital of Nanjing between January 2017 and September 2024. For women with multiple HPV testing records during the study period, only the first test result was retained. HPV positivity, risk-category distribution, infection patterns, and genotype distribution were analyzed by age group. Annual HPV positivity rates were summarized descriptively for 2017–2024. The 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for HPV positivity rates were calculated using the Wilson method. A total of 39,335 women were included, of whom 7,548 were HPV-positive, corresponding to an overall positivity rate of 19.2% (95% CI, 18.8%–19.6%). The HPV positivity rate differed significantly among age groups (χ2=111.104, P < 0.001). The highest positivity rate was observed in women aged 0–19 years, at 44.2% (42/95), followed by those aged 60–69 years, at 26.0% (356/1,368); the lowest rate was observed in women aged 30–39 years, at 17.3% (1,984/11,484). Among HPV-positive women, those aged 40–49 years accounted for the largest proportion (29.2%). Single-type infection was identified in 5,412 women, accounting for 71.7% of HPV-positive women, whereas multiple infection was identified in 2,136 women (28.3%); double, triple, and ≥ 4-type infections accounted for 19.6%, 5.9%, and 2.8%, respectively. High-risk HPV (hrHPV) infection alone accounted for 71.5%, low-risk HPV (lrHPV) infection alone for 14.6%, and concurrent hrHPV and lrHPV infection for 13.9%. A total of 24 HPV genotypes were detected, with HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 showing relatively high detection proportions of 23.8%, 12.6%, and 12.4%, respectively. Among double infections, HPV52 + HPV81 was the most frequently observed genotype combination, detected in 39 women (2.6% of women with double infections). The annual HPV positivity rates from 2017 to 2024 were 32.4%, 22.2%, 25.6%, 18.4%, 17.2%, 15.5%, 16.8%, and 16.8%, respectively, indicating annual fluctuations; the 2024 data covered the period through September only. Among women undergoing HPV testing in Gaochun District, the overall HPV positivity rate was 19.2%, with differences in HPV positivity rates observed among age groups. Single-type infection predominated among HPV-positive women, while HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 were the high-risk genotypes with relatively high detection proportions. Multiple infections showed diverse genotype combinations. The HPV positivity rate fluctuated annually from 2017 to 2024. This study provides continuous baseline data on HPV infection and genotype distribution among women in Gaochun District and may serve as a reference for regional HPV epidemiological surveillance and future related research.

papers.title_zh: 南京市高淳区39335名女性人乳头瘤病毒感染流行病学特征及基因型分布
papers.source_body_en: To characterize HPV positivity, age-specific distribution, infection patterns, genotype distribution, and annual variations in HPV positivity among women undergoing HPV testing at a hospital in Gaochun District, Nanjing, China, and to provide local baseline data for regional HPV surveillance and cervical cancer prevention and control research. This single-center retrospective cross-sectional study included women who underwent HPV testing at Gaochun People’s Hospital of Nanjing between January 2017 and September 2024. For women with multiple HPV testing records during the study period, only the first test result was retained. HPV positivity, risk-category distribution, infection patterns, and genotype distribution were analyzed by age group. Annual HPV positivity rates were summarized descriptively for 2017–2024. The 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for HPV positivity rates were calculated using the Wilson method. A total of 39,335 women were included, of whom 7,548 were HPV-positive, corresponding to an overall positivity rate of 19.2% (95% CI, 18.8%–19.6%). The HPV positivity rate differed significantly among age groups (χ2=111.104, P < 0.001). The highest positivity rate was observed in women aged 0–19 years, at 44.2% (42/95), followed by those aged 60–69 years, at 26.0% (356/1,368); the lowest rate was observed in women aged 30–39 years, at 17.3% (1,984/11,484). Among HPV-positive women, those aged 40–49 years accounted for the largest proportion (29.2%). Single-type infection was identified in 5,412 women, accounting for 71.7% of HPV-positive women, whereas multiple infection was identified in 2,136 women (28.3%); double, triple, and ≥ 4-type infections accounted for 19.6%, 5.9%, and 2.8%, respectively. High-risk HPV (hrHPV) infection alone accounted for 71.5%, low-risk HPV (lrHPV) infection alone for 14.6%, and concurrent hrHPV and lrHPV infection for 13.9%. A total of 24 HPV genotypes were detected, with HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 showing relatively high detection proportions of 23.8%, 12.6%, and 12.4%, respectively. Among double infections, HPV52 + HPV81 was the most frequently observed genotype combination, detected in 39 women (2.6% of women with double infections). The annual HPV positivity rates from 2017 to 2024 were 32.4%, 22.2%, 25.6%, 18.4%, 17.2%, 15.5%, 16.8%, and 16.8%, respectively, indicating annual fluctuations; the 2024 data covered the period through September only. Among women undergoing HPV testing in Gaochun District, the overall HPV positivity rate was 19.2%, with differences in HPV positivity rates observed among age groups. Single-type infection predominated among HPV-positive women, while HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 were the high-risk genotypes with relatively high detection proportions. Multiple infections showed diverse genotype combinations. The HPV positivity rate fluctuated annually from 2017 to 2024. This study provides continuous baseline data on HPV infection and genotype distribution among women in Gaochun District and may serve as a reference for regional HPV epidemiological surveillance and future related research.

papers.title: Conformational Dynamics and Disorder of HPV-16 E6
papers.abstract: Abstract Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) types, notably HPV-16, drives oncogenesis through the multifunctional E6 oncoprotein (16E6), which hijacks host regulatory pathways by engaging diverse protein partners. Despite extensive structural characterization of 16E6 in complex with host targets, the intrinsic dynamics of the unbound 16E6 (apo-16E6) remain unexplored, obscuring our understanding of its conformational ensemble and druggability. Here we characterized the conformational dynamics of full-length apo-16E6 and reveal how intrinsic disorder governs access to its LxxLL-binding groove. We combined exhaustive all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with state-of-the-art enhanced sampling approaches, including well-tempered metadynamics (WT-MetaD) and replica exchange with solute tempering (REST2), to generate an aggregated 47-μs dataset describing the conformational landscape of apo-16E6. Across methods, the interdomain α-helical linker (E6HL) and the C-terminal tail emerge as intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) that choreograph large-amplitude motions of E6N and E6C and spontaneous interdomain opening of apo-16E6 from the closed crystal structure. Neural-network ensemble modeling with BioEmu revealed ordered and disordered states and supports a disorder-to-order transition upon partner engagement. Together, these results establish E6HL and the C-terminal tail as IDRs that modulates groove accessibility, rationalize the breadth of 16E6’s interactome, and motivate ensemble-aware inhibitor discovery aimed at stabilizing open states of 16E6.
papers.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B

source_records.title: Conformational Dynamics and Disorder of HPV-16 E6
source_records.abstract: Abstract Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses drives oncogenesis through the E6 oncoprotein (16E6), which engages diverse host partners through its LxxLL-binding groove. How partner-free 16E6 behaves in solution remains poorly characterized. Here, we combine 35 μs of all-atom molecular dynamics, well-tempered metadynamics, Markov state modeling, and BioEmu ensemble generation to describe apo-16E6. Across all four approaches, the interdomain linker E6HL and the C-terminal tail emerge as intrinsically disordered regions whose dynamics are coupled with LxxLL-groove geometry. A Markov state model resolves open and closed conformational states that differ in E6HL helicity, C-terminal tail extension and groove aperture, interconverting on time scales of at least tens of microseconds. Metadynamics samples three interdomain-separation regions extending to approximately 36 Å, each recurring across the three Q107 rotamers, and BioEmu generates conformers from compact to highly extended. These results are consistent with coupled linker and tail fluctuations underlying a disorder-to-order transition upon partner binding and motivate ensemble-aware inhibitor discovery.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 类型(特别是 HPV-16)的持续感染,通过多功能 E6 癌蛋白 (16E6) 驱动肿瘤发生,该蛋白通过与不同的蛋白伙伴结合来劫持 宿主 调控途径。尽管对与 宿主 靶标复合的 16E6 进行了广泛的结构表征,但未结合的 16E6 (apo-16E6) 的内在动力学仍未得到探索,这模糊了我们对其构象整体和成药性的理解。在这里,我们表征了全长 apo-16E6 的构象动力学,并揭示了内在无序如何控制对其 LxxLL 结合沟的访问。我们将详尽的全原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟与最先进的增强采样方法相结合,包括调和元动力学 (WT-MetaD) 和溶质调温复制交换 (REST2),生成描述 apo-16E6 构象景观的 47 μs 聚合数据集。在各种方法中,域间 α-螺旋接头 (E6HL) 和 C 末端尾部作为本质无序区域 (IDR) 出现,它们编排 E6N 和 E6C 的大幅运动以及 apo-16E6 从闭合晶体结构自发域间打开。使用 BioEmu 进行的神经网络集成建模揭示了有序和无序状态,并支持合作伙伴参与时从无序到有序的转变。总之,这些结果将 E6HL 和 C 末端尾部确定为 IDR,可调节凹槽可及性,合理化 16E6 相互作用组的宽度,并激发旨在稳定 16E6 开放状态的整体感知抑制剂的发现。

papers.title: A regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines immobilization and CuNCs for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus 16 (HPV16) is a subtype of high-risk human papillomavirus and is closely associated with approximately 50% of cervical cancers and certain other cancers of the reproductive system. This work developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA. The PolyA probe was immobilized on the electrode due to the high affinity between the PolyA sequence and the gold nanoparticles. Then the duplex DNA partially hybridized with the PolyA probe and templated the systhysis of CuNCs, resulting in a high impedance. In the presence of HPV16 DNA, the target hybridized with the duplex DNA template and led the release of the duplex from the electrode surface. The amount of the CuNCs thus decreased and a low impedance was obtained. In addition, after finishing the detection of HPV16 DNA, the developed sensor was easily regenerated by incubating with the duplex DNA template. The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work. The analytical performance of the three kinds of sensors were compared and the PolyA based regenerable biosensor exhibited the lowest limit of detection of 26.49 pM. Moreover, the developed regenerable biosensor performed the satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability and recoveries. It will have important applications in the sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of other DNA and targets.
papers.journal: Journal of Electrochemical Science and Technology

source_records.abstract: Human papillomavirus 16 (HPV16) is a subtype of high-risk human papillomavirus and is closely associated with approximately 50% of cervical cancers and certain other cancers of the reproductive system.This work developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA.The PolyA probe was immobilized on the electrode due to the high affinity between the PolyA sequence and the gold nanoparticles.Then the duplex DNA partially hybridized with the PolyA probe and templated the systhysis of CuNCs, resulting in a high impedance.In the presence of HPV16 DNA, the target hybridized with the duplex DNA template and led the release of the duplex from the electrode surface.The amount of the CuNCs thus decreased and a low impedance was obtained.In addition, after finishing the detection of HPV16 DNA, the developed sensor was easily regenerated by incubating with the duplex DNA template.The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work.The analytical performance of the three kinds of sensors were compared and the PolyA based regenerable biosensor exhibited the lowest limit of detection of 26.49 pM.Moreover, the developed regenerable biosensor performed the satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability and recoveries.It will have important applications in the sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of other DNA and targets.

papers.abstract_original: Human papillomavirus 16 (HPV16) is a subtype of high-risk human papillomavirus and is closely associated with approximately 50% of cervical cancers and certain other cancers of the reproductive system. This work developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA. The PolyA probe was immobilized on the electrode due to the high affinity between the PolyA sequence and the gold nanoparticles. Then the duplex DNA partially hybridized with the PolyA probe and templated the systhysis of CuNCs, resulting in a high impedance. In the presence of HPV16 DNA, the target hybridized with the duplex DNA template and led the release of the duplex from the electrode surface. The amount of the CuNCs thus decreased and a low impedance was obtained. In addition, after finishing the detection of HPV16 DNA, the developed sensor was easily regenerated by incubating with the duplex DNA template. The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work. The analytical performance of the three kinds of sensors were compared and the PolyA based regenerable biosensor exhibited the lowest limit of detection of 26.49 pM. Moreover, the developed regenerable biosensor performed the satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability and recoveries. It will have important applications in the sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of other DNA and targets.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a regenerable electrochemical biosensor for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA, addressing the need for improved methods in HPV-associated cervical cancer diagnosis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for HPV16 DNA detection, using a gold-silver (Au-S) electrode and comparing it with unregenerable biosensors.
analysis.methods: The PolyA probe was immobilized on the Au-S electrode, and CuNCs were templated by the hybridized duplex DNA, leading to impedance changes that were detected electrochemically.
analysis.main_results: The developed regenerable biosensor exhibited a low limit of detection of 26.49 pM and demonstrated satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability, and recoveries.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as showing the potential of the regenerable biosensor for sensitive and selective detection of HPV16 DNA, with implications for improving diagnostic tools.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could lead to better and more efficient detection methods for HPV16, aiding in the early diagnosis and management of HPV-associated cervical cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the need for further validation in clinical settings and the potential for sample-to-sample variability, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor for sensitive HPV16 DNA detection, demonstrating low detection limits and promising performance characteristics. The sensor could improve diagnostic tools for HPV-associated cervical cancer.

The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work. papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 16 (HPV16) 是高危 人乳头瘤病毒 的一种亚型,与约 50% 的 宫颈癌 和某些其他生殖系统癌症密切相关。这项工作开发了一种基于连续腺嘌呤 (PolyA) 固定化和铜纳米簇 (CuNC) 的可再生电化学生物传感器,用于灵敏检测 HPV16 DNA。由于PolyA序列和金纳米颗粒之间的高亲和力,PolyA探针被固定在电极上。然后,双链 DNA 与 PolyA 探针部分杂交,并以 CuNC 合成为模板,产生高阻抗。在 HPV16 DNA 存在的情况下,靶标与双链体 DNA 模板杂交并导致双链体从电极表面释放。CuNCs的量因此减少并且获得低阻抗。此外,在完成HPV16 DNA的检测后,所开发的传感器通过与双链DNA模板一起孵育很容易再生。在这项工作中,还开发了基于 Au-S 和基于 PolyA 的不可再生生物传感器用于 HPV16 DNA 测定。比较了三种传感器的分析性能,基于PolyA的可再生生物传感器的最低检测限为26.49 pM。此外,所开发的可再生生物传感器具有令人满意的重复性、再现性、选择性、再生性和回收率。它将在其他 DNA 和靶标的灵敏和选择性电化学测定中具有重要应用。

papers.title: Dynamics-Driven Characterization of Flavonol Binding to the HPV16 E6 Oncoprotein: Energetic and Molecular Interaction Analysis
papers.abstract: Human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) E6 is a key viral oncoprotein that suppresses apoptotic signaling and promotes malignant progression, making it an important therapeutic target. Although several flavonol compounds have been reported to inhibit E6-mediated interactions, the molecular determinants underlying their differing inhibitory activities remain unclear. In this study, we investigated six experimentally validated flavonol inhibitors using molecular docking, explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulations, molecular mechanics Poisson–Boltzmann surface area (MM/PBSA) and molecular mechanics generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) binding free-energy calculations, per-residue energy decomposition, and hydrogen-bond occupancy analysis. Docking identified a common binding pocket overlapping the reported LXXLL interaction region and revealed distinct ligand orientations within this pocket. The 300 ns simulations showed bounded root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) behavior and maintained overall structural compactness while revealing ligand-dependent conformational fluctuations. Despite favorable docking scores and binding free energies, neither approach reproduced the experimental potency ranking, indicating that these calculated metrics alone do not explain the observed differences in inhibitory potency. Residue-level decomposition revealed ligand-dependent energetic contributions from hydrophobic and polar residues within the binding region. Notably, myricetin, the most potent inhibitor experimentally, displayed persistent hydrogen bonds with ASP48 and ARG128, whereas CYS50-centered interactions were more prominent for several other flavonols. papers.abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型 (HPV16) E6 是一种关键的病毒癌蛋白,可抑制细胞凋亡信号传导并促进恶性进展,使其成为重要的治疗靶点。尽管已报道几种黄酮醇化合物可抑制 E6 介导的相互作用,但其不同抑制活性背后的分子决定因素仍不清楚。在本研究中,我们使用分子对接、显式溶剂分子动力学模拟、分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积 (MM/PBSA) 和分子力学广义玻恩表面积 (MM/GBSA) 结合自由能计算、每个残基能量分解和氢键占据分析,研究了六种经过实验验证的黄酮醇抑制剂。对接确定了一个与报道的 LXXLL 相互作用区域重叠的共同结合袋,并揭示了该袋内不同的配体方向。300 ns 模拟显示有界均方根偏差 (RMSD) 行为并保持整体结构紧凑性,同时揭示配体依赖性构象波动。尽管具有良好的对接分数和结合自由能,但这两种方法都没有重现实验效力排名,表明这些计算的指标本身并不能解释观察到的抑制效力差异。残基水平分解揭示了结合区域内疏水性和极性残基的配体依赖性能量贡献。值得注意的是,实验中最有效的抑制剂杨梅素与 ASP48 和 ARG128 表现出持久的氢键,而对于其他几种黄酮醇,以 CYS50 为中心的相互作用更为突出。这些发现表明,没有单一的相互作用可以解释实验效力模式,而是支持配体依赖性识别机制,涉及方向、残基水平能量贡献和持久的分子间接触,为未来 HPV16 E6 抑制剂的优化提供分子洞察。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the relationship between educational attainment and knowledge about the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among mothers of adolescent girls in the Mekong Delta, Vietnam, to address disparities in health information access.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted in Can Tho City, Vietnam, from December 2024 to December 2025, involving 387 mothers of girls aged 9-17 years.
analysis.methods: The study used a de-identified dataset and analysis code to assess knowledge of HPV vaccines through structured questionnaires administered to the participants.
analysis.main_results: The survey found that higher educational attainment was associated with greater knowledge of HPV vaccines, with 78% of mothers with higher education reporting accurate information compared to 52% of those with lower education.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of educational disparities in HPV vaccine knowledge, highlighting the need for targeted health education programs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that improving educational access could enhance HPV vaccine awareness and potentially improve vaccination rates among adolescent girls in the region.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the sample size may not fully represent the broader population in the Mekong Delta.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Can Tho City, Vietnam, examined the relationship between educational attainment and knowledge of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among 387 mothers of adolescent girls. The survey, conducted from December 2024 to December 2025, found that 78% of mothers with higher education reported accurate HPV vaccine knowledge, compared to 52% with lower education. The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of educational disparities in health information access, suggesting that targeted health education programs could improve HPV vaccine awareness. The study's results highlight the importance of education in public health initiatives related to HPV prevention. However, the cross-sectional design limits the ability to establish causality, and the sample size may not fully represent the broader population in the Mekong Delta. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

elements_en.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted in Can Tho City, Vietnam, from December 2024 to December 2025, involving 387 mothers of girls aged 9-17 years.
elements_en.methods: The study used a de-identified dataset and analysis code to assess knowledge of HPV vaccines through structured questionnaires administered to the participants.
elements_en.main_results: The survey found that higher educational attainment was associated with greater knowledge of HPV vaccines, with 78% of mothers with higher education reporting accurate information compared to 52% of those with lower education.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of educational disparities in HPV vaccine knowledge, highlighting the need for targeted health education programs.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that improving educational access could enhance HPV vaccine awareness and potentially improve vaccination rates among adolescent girls in the region.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the sample size may not fully represent the broader population in the Mekong Delta.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查越南湄公河三角洲少女母亲的教育程度与 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 知识之间的关系,以解决健康信息获取方面的差异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024年12月至2025年12月,在越南芹苴市进行了一项基于社区的横断面调查,涉及387名9至17岁女孩的母亲。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用去识别化的数据集和分析代码,通过向参与者发放结构化问卷来评估 HPV 疫苗 的知识。
elements_zh.main_results: 调查发现,受教育程度越高,对 HPV 疫苗 的了解越多,受教育程度较高的母亲中有 78% 报告了准确的信息,而受教育程度较低的母亲中这一比例为 52%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 HPV 疫苗 知识教育差异的证据,强调了有针对性的健康教育计划的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,改善教育机会可以提高该地区少女中 HPV 疫苗 的认识,并有可能提高 疫苗接种 率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,而且样本量可能无法完全代表湄公河三角洲更广泛的人口。
