It also highlights the need for further studies to resolve the conflicting results on the efficacy of RIT in HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer. In practice, these findings may inform treatment strategies for patients with HPV-associated head and neck cancers, particularly those with intermediate-risk features or extensive neck dissection.

papers.title_zh: [头颈癌的放射治疗:2026 年 ASCO 年会亮点]。
papers.source_body_en: At the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting, several studies focused on radiotherapy of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC). The phase III AREST trial showed that adjuvant radiotherapy for early oral cavity cancer with intermediate-risk features can reduce the risk of locoregional recurrence. A post hoc analysis of the JCOG1008 trial found no increased locoregional recurrence rate even when adjuvant chemoradiotherapy was initiated later than recommended. Combined radioimmunotherapy (RIT) was also a major topic this year: in a subgroup analysis of the NIVOPOSTOP trial, the disease-free survival (DFS) benefit of nivolumab was maintained in patients with extensive neck dissection, which weakens the frequently highlighted mechanistic relevance of regional lymph nodes for the immune response. In the treatment of human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive oropharyngeal cancer, results for RIT were conflicting: the phase II CCTG HN.9 trial evaluating radiotherapy combined with durvalumab failed to meet its efficacy endpoint, whereas the phase II KEYCHAIN trial of definitive RIT with pembrolizumab demonstrated a significant improvement in progression-free survival (PFS) compared with cisplatin-based chemoradiotherapy. In addition, a subgroup analysis of the combined positive score (CPS) ≥ 10 population of the KEYNOTE-412 trial underscored the importance of biomarker-based patient selection when combining radiotherapy and immunotherapy.
papers.abstract_zh: 在2026年美国临床肿瘤学会(ASCO)年会上,多项研究聚焦于头颈鳞状细胞癌(HNSCC)的放射治疗。III期AREST试验表明,对具有中危特征的早期口腔癌进行辅助放疗可以降低局部复发的风险。JCOG1008 试验的事后分析发现,即使辅助放化疗开始时间晚于推荐时间,局部复发率也没有增加。联合放射免疫治疗 (RIT) 也是今年的一个主要话题:在 NIVOPOSTOP 试验的亚组分析中,纳武单抗在广泛颈清扫患者中维持了无病生存 (DFS) 益处,这削弱了经常强调的区域淋巴结与 免疫应答 的机械相关性。在 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 阳性口咽癌的 治疗 中,RIT 的结果是相互矛盾的:评估放疗联合 durvalumab 的 II 期 CCTG HN.9 试验未能达到其疗效终点,而联合派姆单抗确定性 RIT 的 II 期 KEYCHAIN 试验表明,与基于顺铂的放化疗相比,无进展生存期 (PFS) 显着改善。此外,对 KEYNOTE-412 试验的综合阳性评分 (CPS) ≥ 10 人群进行的亚组分析强调了结合放疗和免疫治疗时基于生物标志物的患者选择的重要性。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 在头颈癌中的作用,特别是与放射治疗及其对局部复发和生存结果的影响有关。核心问题是口咽癌等 HPV 相关疾病是否受益于特定的放射治疗方法,包括联合放射免疫治疗。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查基于 2026 年 ASCO 年会的结果,包括 III 期 AREST 试验、JCOG1008 试验的事后分析以及 NIVOPOSTOP 和 KEYNOTE-412 试验的亚组分析。这些研究的选择是基于它们与 HPV 相关疾病的相关性以及它们对放射治疗结果的关注。该综述没有明确描述荟萃分析或共识过程,但总结了这些试验的主要结果。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调,对具有中等风险特征的早期口腔癌进行辅助放疗可以减少局部复发。此外,它指出,纳武单抗在联合放射​​免疫治疗 (RIT) 中的 DFS 益处在广泛颈清扫患者中得以维持,这表明区域淋巴结对于 免疫应答 可能并不像之前认为的那么重要。然而,RIT 在 HPV 阳性口咽癌中的结果是相互矛盾的,CCTG HN.9 试验未能达到其疗效终点,而 KEYCHAIN 试验显示与基于顺铂的放化疗相比,无进展生存期 (PFS) 显着改善。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于联合放射免疫治疗 (RIT) 对 HPV 阳性口咽癌的疗效存在争议,因为 CCTG HN.9 试验未达到其疗效终点,而 KEYCHAIN 试验显示 PFS 显着改善。此外,该评论指出,KEYNOTE-412 试验的亚组分析强调了在放射治疗和免疫治疗相结合时基于生物标志物的患者选择的重要性,这表明在理解如何为此类 治疗 最佳选择患者方面存在差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,未来的研究应重点关注针对 HPV 相关癌症的联合放疗和免疫治疗方法,完善基于生物标志物的患者选择。它还强调需要进一步研究来解决 RIT 对 HPV 阳性口咽癌疗效的相互矛盾的结果。在实践中,这些发现可能为 HPV 相关头颈癌患者的 治疗 策略提供参考,特别是那些具有中等风险特征或广泛颈清扫术的患者。

papers.title: Awareness and knowledge of cervical cancer prevention and HPV vaccination among university students in Pakistan: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide, despite being largely preventable. Its burden remains high in settings without organized vaccination and screening programs. Knowledge and awareness of cervical cancer prevention and human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination may influence the acceptance of preventive measures. This study aimed to assess knowledge and awareness of cervical cancer prevention and HPV vaccination among university students in Lahore, Pakistan, and to identify their main sources of health information. Methods A structured, quantitative, online survey in English was administered to students enrolled in medical-related programs at the University of Lahore, Pakistan. Results A total of 163 students participated. Knowledge of cervical cancer, HPV, and preventive measures was low to moderate. Only 69 participants (42%) recognized HPV infection as a risk factor, and 56 (34%) were unaware that cervical cancer can be prevented through Pap smear screening. Among female respondents, only 10 (12%) perceived themselves to be at risk. Knowledge of HPV transmission and vaccination was limited, with uncertainty regarding the purpose, timing, and benefits. Willingness to receive the HPV vaccine was moderate (62%). The main sources of health information were educational institutions, social media, and healthcare professionals, with healthcare professionals and educational institutions reported as the most trusted. Conclusions Despite a relatively educated population, knowledge of cervical cancer prevention and HPV vaccination remains insufficient. Targeted educational interventions and comprehensive public health strategies, including culturally sensitive communication and access to vaccination and screening programs, are essential to enhance preventive outcomes.

papers.title_zh: 巴基斯坦大学生对 宫颈癌 预防和 HPV 疫苗接种 的认识和了解:一项横断面研究
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide, despite being largely preventable. Its burden remains high in settings without organized vaccination and screening programs. Knowledge and awareness of cervical cancer prevention and human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination may influence the acceptance of preventive measures. This study aimed to assess knowledge and awareness of cervical cancer prevention and HPV vaccination among university students in Lahore, Pakistan, and to identify their main sources of health information. Methods A structured, quantitative, online survey in English was administered to students enrolled in medical-related programs at the University of Lahore, Pakistan. Results A total of 163 students participated. Knowledge of cervical cancer, HPV, and preventive measures was low to moderate. Only 69 participants (42%) recognized HPV infection as a risk factor, and 56 (34%) were unaware that cervical cancer can be prevented through Pap smear screening. Among female respondents, only 10 (12%) perceived themselves to be at risk. Knowledge of HPV transmission and vaccination was limited, with uncertainty regarding the purpose, timing, and benefits. Willingness to receive the HPV vaccine was moderate (62%). The main sources of health information were educational institutions, social media, and healthcare professionals, with healthcare professionals and educational institutions reported as the most trusted. Conclusions Despite a relatively educated population, knowledge of cervical cancer prevention and HPV vaccination remains insufficient. Targeted educational interventions and comprehensive public health strategies, including culturally sensitive communication and access to vaccination and screening programs, are essential to enhance preventive outcomes.

papers.title: A qualitative evaluation of a STEAM (Science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics) peer education intervention on teenagers' knowledge, confidence, and advocacy for HPV vaccine communication.
papers.abstract: Vaccine hesitancy is a rising global phenomenon. Ireland experienced a crisis in confidence and vaccine decline for the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in 2015, with rapid national efforts to address concerns and improve uptake rates. We developed a unique STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics) peer education intervention through an interdisciplinary team (immunologist, educationalist, designer, filmmaker, and psychologist) to address vaccine hesitancy and utilize peer education, which is promising but underused in the literature. We aimed to evaluate the effect of our STEAM intervention on Irish teenagers' knowledge and confidence in advocacy for the HPV vaccine to their younger peers facing their HPV vaccine offer. We used qualitative methods consisting of 12 focus group discussions with teens (n = 53), one qualitative in-class evaluation among younger peers (n = 35), and knowledge exit slips (n = 300) to evaluate teenagers' knowledge, confidence, advocacy, and younger peers' knowledge. Data were analyzed inductively using reflexive thematic analysis. Our overall egalitarian theme indicated democratic participation by teenagers with three related themes that were compatible with behavior as a vaccine advocate. Teenagers reported positive changes overall in HPV knowledge, confidence, and advocacy beliefs following the intervention. Younger peers could recall HPV facts and knowledge during in-class evaluations and exit slips. We conclude that scaffolding through our STEAM intervention enabled Irish teenagers to feel empowered to act as vaccine advocates. Peer education within our intervention shows promise in raising HPV awareness and knowledge and could be explored in wider contexts.

papers.source_body_en: Vaccine hesitancy is a rising global phenomenon. Ireland experienced a crisis in confidence and vaccine decline for the Human Papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine in 2015, with rapid national efforts to address concerns and improve uptake rates. We developed a unique STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics) peer education intervention through an interdisciplinary team (immunologist, educationalist, designer, filmmaker, and psychologist) to address vaccine hesitancy and utilize peer education, which is promising but underused in the literature. We aimed to evaluate the effect of our STEAM intervention on Irish teenagers' knowledge and confidence in advocacy for the HPV vaccine to their younger peers facing their HPV vaccine offer. We used qualitative methods consisting of 12 focus group discussions with teens (n = 53), one qualitative in-class evaluation among younger peers (n = 35), and knowledge exit slips (n = 300) to evaluate teenagers' knowledge, confidence, advocacy, and younger peers' knowledge. Data were analyzed inductively using reflexive thematic analysis. Our overall egalitarian theme indicated democratic participation by teenagers with three related themes that were compatible with behavior as a vaccine advocate. Teenagers reported positive changes overall in HPV knowledge, confidence, and advocacy beliefs following the intervention. Younger peers could recall HPV facts and knowledge during in-class evaluations and exit slips. We conclude that scaffolding through our STEAM intervention enabled Irish teenagers to feel empowered to act as vaccine advocates. Peer education within our intervention shows promise in raising HPV awareness and knowledge and could be explored in wider contexts.

papers.title: Phenolic Hydroxyl-Containing Lipid Nanoparticles Enable Codelivery of HPV Peptide Antigens and Manganese Adjuvant for Cancer Immunotherapy.
papers.abstract: Abstract Therapeutic peptide vaccines against HPV-associated cancers are often limited by insufficient immunogenicity and inefficient intracellular delivery. Here, we develop a phenolic hydroxyl-containing lipid nanoparticle (EMT@LNP) as a nanomedicine platform for the coordinated codelivery of HPV16 E6/E7 peptide antigens and manganese (Mn2+) adjuvant. Distinct from conventional electrostatic loading strategies, EMT@LNP exploits hydrogen-bonding interactions between phenolic hydroxyl groups and peptide antigens, enabling charge-independent loading of peptides with diverse physicochemical properties, while coordination interactions between phenolic moieties and Mn2+ allow the simultaneous incorporation of immunostimulatory adjuvants. This dual-interaction-driven design integrates antigen delivery and innate immune activation within a single nanostructure. Functionally, EMT@LNP enhances antigen uptake and promotes dendritic cell maturation, accompanied by activation of STING-associated signaling, as indicated by increased phosphorylation of STING, TBK1, and IRF3. In vivo, EMT@LNP facilitates efficient delivery to draining lymph nodes and prolongs antigen retention following intramuscular administration. In a therapeutic TC-1 tumor model, EMT@LNP elicits potent antitumor immune responses, characterized by enhanced CD8+ T-cell infiltration and reduced immunosuppressive cell populations, leading to significant tumor growth inhibition without observable systemic toxicity. Collectively, this study presents a nanobiotechnology strategy that combines charge-independent peptide loading with metal-ion-mediated immune activation, providing a versatile and potentially translatable platform for therapeutic vaccination against HPV-associated malignancies.

Here, we develop a phenolic hydroxyl-containing lipid nanoparticle (EMT@LNP) as a nanomedicine platform for the coordinated codelivery of HPV16 E6/E7 peptide antigens and manganese (Mn2+) adjuvant. Distinct from conventional electrostatic loading strategies, EMT@LNP exploits hydrogen-bonding interactions between phenolic hydroxyl groups and peptide antigens, enabling charge-independent loading of peptides with diverse physicochemical properties, while coordination interactions between phenolic moieties and Mn2+ allow the simultaneous incorporation of immunostimulatory adjuvants. This dual-interaction-driven design integrates antigen delivery and innate immune activation within a single nanostructure. Functionally, EMT@LNP enhances antigen uptake and promotes dendritic cell maturation, accompanied by activation of STING-associated signaling, as indicated by increased phosphorylation of STING, TBK1, and IRF3. In vivo, EMT@LNP facilitates efficient delivery to draining lymph nodes and prolongs antigen retention following intramuscular administration. In a therapeutic TC-1 tumor model, EMT@LNP elicits potent antitumor immune responses, characterized by enhanced CD8+ T-cell infiltration and reduced immunosuppressive cell populations, leading to significant tumor growth inhibition without observable systemic toxicity. Collectively, this study presents a nanobiotechnology strategy that combines charge-independent peptide loading with metal-ion-mediated immune activation, providing a versatile and potentially translatable platform for therapeutic vaccination against HPV-associated malignancies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to address the limitations of therapeutic peptide vaccines against HPV-associated cancers, specifically insufficient immunogenicity and inefficient intracellular delivery, by developing a novel nanomedicine platform.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a phenolic hydroxyl-containing lipid nanoparticle (EMT@LNP) as a nanomedicine platform for the coordinated codelivery of HPV16 E6/E7 peptide antigens and manganese (Mn2+) adjuvant. The platform was tested in a therapeutic TC-1 tumor model.
analysis.methods: EMT@LNP was designed to exploit hydrogen-bonding interactions between phenolic hydroxyl groups and peptide antigens, enabling charge-independent loading of peptides with diverse physicochemical properties. Coordination interactions between phenolic moieties and Mn2+ allowed the simultaneous incorporation of immunostimulatory adjuvants.
analysis.main_results: Functionally, EMT@LNP enhanced antigen uptake and promoted dendritic cell maturation, accompanied by activation of STING-associated signaling, as indicated by increased phosphorylation of STING, TBK1, and IRF3. In vivo, it facilitated efficient delivery to draining lymph nodes and prolonged antigen retention following intramuscular administration.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of a novel nanobiotechnology strategy that combines charge-independent peptide loading with metal-ion-mediated immune activation, offering a versatile platform for therapeutic vaccination against HPV-associated malignancies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that EMT@LNP could inform the development of more effective therapeutic vaccines for HPV-associated cancers, potentially improving immunogenicity and treatment outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only analysis, and the evidence is based on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully represent clinical scenarios. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel nanomedicine platform, EMT@LNP, designed to enhance therapeutic peptide vaccines against HPV-associated cancers. The platform leverages hydrogen-bonding interactions for charge-independent peptide loading and coordination interactions for incorporating manganese adjuvants. It demonstrates improved antigen uptake, dendritic cell maturation, and STING signaling activation in vitro, along with efficient lymph node delivery and prolonged antigen retention in vivo. In a TC-1 tumor model, EMT@LNP elicited strong antitumor immune responses, including enhanced CD8+ T-cell infiltration and reduced immunosuppressive cell populations, resulting in significant tumor growth inhibition without systemic toxicity. The study presents a promising strategy for therapeutic vaccination against HPV-related malignancies, though the evidence is based on abstract-only data and in vivo models, limiting its clinical applicability. The findings suggest potential for improved immunotherapeutic approaches but require further validation in clinical settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过开发新型纳米医学平台,解决治疗性肽 疫苗 针对 HPV 相关癌症的局限性,特别是免疫原性不足和细胞内递送效率低下。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种含酚羟基的脂质纳米颗粒(EMT@LNP)作为纳米医学平台,用于协同递送 HPV16 E6/E7 肽抗原和锰(Mn2+)佐剂。该平台在治疗性 TC-1 肿瘤模型中进行了测试。
elements_zh.methods: EMT@LNP 旨在利用酚羟基和肽抗原之间的氢键相互作用,从而实现具有不同理化性质的肽的电荷独立负载。酚类部分和 Mn2+ 之间的配位相互作用允许同时掺入免疫刺激佐剂。
elements_zh.main_results: 从功能上讲,EMT@LNP 增强了抗原摄取并促进树突状细胞成熟,同时激活 STING 相关信号传导,如 STING、TBK1 和 IRF3 磷酸化增加所示。在体内,它有助于有效递送至引流淋巴结并延长肌肉注射后的抗原保留时间。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为一种新颖的纳米生物技术策略的证据,该策略将电荷无关的肽负载与金属离子介导的免疫激活相结合,为 疫苗接种 治疗 HPV 相关恶性肿瘤提供了一个多功能平台。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,EMT@LNP 可以为针对 HPV 相关癌症开发更有效的治疗药物 疫苗 提供信息,从而有可能改善免疫原性和 治疗 结局。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象分析,证据基于体外和体内模型,可能无法完全代表临床情况。证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 针对 HPV 相关癌症的治疗性肽 疫苗 通常受到免疫原性不足和细胞内递送效率低下的限制。在这里,我们开发了一种含酚羟基的脂质纳米颗粒(EMT@LNP)作为纳米医学平台,用于协调共递送 HPV16 E6/E7 肽抗原和锰(Mn2+)佐剂。与传统的静电负载策略不同,EMT@LNP利用酚羟基和肽抗原之间的氢键相互作用,实现具有不同理化性质的肽的电荷独立负载,而酚部分和Mn2+之间的配位相互作用允许同时掺入免疫刺激佐剂。这种双重相互作用驱动的设计将抗原递送和先天免疫激活集成在单个纳米结构内。从功能上讲,EMT@LNP 增强抗原摄取并促进树突状细胞成熟,同时激活 STING 相关信号传导,如 STING、TBK1 和 IRF3 磷酸化增加所示。在体内,EMT@LNP 有助于有效递送至引流淋巴结,并延长肌肉注射后的抗原保留时间。在治疗性 TC-1 肿瘤模型中,EMT@LNP 引发有效的抗肿瘤 免疫应答,其特点是增强 CD8+ T 细胞浸润和减少免疫抑制细胞群,从而导致显着的肿瘤生长抑制,且没有可观察到的全身毒性。总的来说,这项研究提出了一种纳米生物技术策略,将电荷无关的肽负载与金属离子介导的免疫激活相结合,为 疫苗接种 治疗 HPV 相关恶性肿瘤提供了一个多功能且潜在可转化的平台。

papers.title: Vaccines for Cancer: A Translational Science Review.
papers.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Advances in tumor immunology and vaccine technology are reshaping cancer vaccine development after decades of limited clinical success. More than 2000 immunogenic tumor proteins or antigens have been identified, the types of immune responses required for tumor eradication have been defined, and safe and effective vaccine delivery technologies have been developed. This progress has renewed clinical investigation of cancer vaccines for multiple types of cancer. OBSERVATIONS: Vaccines, such as those against human papillomavirus and hepatitis B, are composed of (1) an antigen target, (2) an adjuvant to activate the immune system, and (3) a vaccine delivery vehicle. Antigens can be derived from tumor mutations termed neoantigens, or cancer-associated nonmutated proteins, which are normal human proteins that are abnormally expressed in cancer. The tumor can also act as an antigen source, such as when immunization occurs with whole tumor cells or by directly injecting an immunogenic substance into the tumor to elicit an adaptive immune response. T and B lymphocytes, cells of the adaptive immune system, are stimulated by cancer vaccines and can provide a highly specific and durable immune response directed against cancer. Vaccines that elicit adaptive immunity are approved for cancer treatment. Sipuleucel-T, a vaccine against the antigen prostatic acid phosphatase, reduced all-cause mortality compared with placebo in men with metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer (32% vs 23%; hazard ratio, 0.78 [95% CI, 0.61-0.98]; P = .03). Compared with granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor, a systemic immune stimulant, talimogene laherparepvec increased rates of a 6-month or longer complete or partial response, defined as the disappearance of all treated disease and at least a 50% decrease in the sum of the products of perpendicular diameters of the measurable lesion with no new lesions, respectively, when injected into advanced melanoma lesions (16.3% [95% CI, 12.1%-20.5%] vs 2.1% [95% CI, 0%-4.5%]; odds ratio, 8.9; P < .001). Most cancer vaccines have mild adverse effects, such as fatigue, fever, and injection site reactions. Combining cancer vaccines with chemotherapy or immunotherapy can increase the magnitude of the immune response and potentially result in greater reduction in cancer size. Combining the personalized mutation-based messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccine (mRNA-4157) with the immune checkpoint inhibitor pembrolizumab for resected high-risk stage IIIB to IV cutaneous melanoma improved relapse-free survival compared with pembrolizumab alone (76.6% vs 60%; hazard ratio, 0.56 [95% CI, 0.31-1.02]; P = .05). Cancer vaccines are undergoing evaluation in clinical trials to prevent cancer recurrence and for primary cancer prevention. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Cancer vaccines can treat several types of malignant neoplasms, including melanoma, prostate cancer, and bladder cancer. Adverse effects associated with cancer vaccines are generally mild and of short duration, promoting eventual integration of vaccination into treatment regimens with chemotherapy and immunotherapy. Cancer vaccines are increasingly undergoing evaluation for primary prevention.

papers.title_original: Vaccines for Cancer: A Translational Science Review.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on cancer vaccines, particularly those targeting human papillomaviruses (HPV), with an emphasis on their role in treating and preventing HPV-associated malignancies such as cervical, anal, and oropharyngeal cancers. The central question is whether cancer vaccines can effectively treat and prevent these specific HPV-related diseases.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of cancer vaccines, including their development, mechanisms, and clinical applications. It references studies on vaccines like Sipuleucel-T and talimogene laherparepvec, which are evaluated for their efficacy in treating specific cancers. The review also discusses the general progress in identifying immunogenic tumor proteins and developing safe vaccine delivery technologies.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Cancer vaccines have shown efficacy in treating certain HPV-associated cancers, such as melanoma, prostate cancer, and bladder cancer. These vaccines stimulate T and B lymphocytes to produce a specific and durable immune response against cancer. Additionally, they are being evaluated for primary prevention of cancer recurrence and for preventing cancer in the first place.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that while some vaccines have demonstrated effectiveness, the evidence for their use in other cancers remains limited. There are also gaps in understanding the long-term effects of these vaccines and their potential for broader application across different cancer types.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to evaluate the effectiveness of cancer vaccines in preventing cancer recurrence and for primary prevention. Clinical trials should focus on expanding the use of these vaccines to other HPV-associated cancers and improving their integration with existing treatments like chemotherapy and immunotherapy.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the development and application of cancer vaccines targeting human papillomaviruses (HPV), emphasizing their role in treating and preventing HPV-associated malignancies such as cervical, anal, and oropharyngeal cancers. It highlights the progress in identifying immunogenic tumor proteins and safe vaccine delivery technologies, as well as the clinical success of vaccines like Sipuleucel-T and talimogene laherparepvec. The review concludes that these vaccines can treat several cancers, including melanoma, prostate cancer, and bladder cancer, and are being evaluated for primary prevention. However, there are controversies and evidence gaps regarding their broader application and long-term effects. Research and clinical trials are recommended to further assess their potential in preventing cancer recurrence and for primary prevention.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是癌症 疫苗,特别是那些针对 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 的药物,重点是它们在治疗和预防 HPV 相关恶性肿瘤(如宫颈癌、肛门癌和口咽癌)中的作用。核心问题是癌症疫苗能否有效治疗和预防这些特定的HPV相关疾病。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对癌症 疫苗 的系统分析,包括其发展、机制和临床应用。它引用了 疫苗 的研究,例如 Sipuleucel-T 和 talimogene laherparepvec,这些研究评估了它们在治疗特定癌症方面的功效。该综述还讨论了识别免疫原性肿瘤蛋白和开发安全的 疫苗 递送技术的总体进展。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 癌症 疫苗 已显示出治疗某些 HPV 相关癌症的功效,例如黑色素瘤、前列腺癌和膀胱癌。这些 疫苗 刺激 T 和 B 淋巴细胞产生特异性且持久的 免疫应答 抗癌药物。此外,正在对它们进行癌症复发一级预防和预防癌症的评估。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论强调,虽然一些 疫苗 已被证明有效,但其用于其他癌症的证据仍然有限。在理解这些 疫苗 的长期影响及其在不同癌症类型中更广泛应用的潜力方面也存在差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要进一步的研究来评估癌症 疫苗 在预防癌症复发和一级预防方面的有效性。临床试验应侧重于将这些 疫苗 的使用范围扩大到其他 HPV 相关癌症,并改善其与现有 治疗(如化疗和免疫疗法)的整合。

papers.title: Navigating HPV vaccination challenges in low-resource settings: Practical strategies for estimating the size of out-of-school girls.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Achieving the 2030 target of 90% human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination coverage among girls by age 15 requires effectively reaching out-of-school (OOS) girls, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) where most vaccine delivery occurs in school settings. This study explored country definitions of OOS girls and strategies for estimating the size of this population. METHODS: Between May and September 2024, we conducted semi-structured in-depth interviews with 32 HPV vaccine program stakeholders across six African and Asian LMICs with established HPV vaccination programs: Cambodia, Cameroon, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, and Uganda. Using hybrid inductive-deductive thematic analyses, we identified country approaches to defining OOS girls and to enumerating or estimating population size. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨各国对失学 (OOS) 女童的定义以及估算中低收入国家 (LMIC) 女童人口规模的策略,以应对在 2030 年实现 15 岁女童 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率 90% 的目标方面所面临的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2024 年 5 月至 9 月期间对来自 6 个非洲和亚洲中低收入国家(柬埔寨、喀麦隆、肯尼亚、马拉维、莫桑比克和乌干达)的 32 名 HPV 疫苗 项目利益相关者进行了半结构化深入访谈。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用半结构化深入访谈和混合归纳演绎主题分析来确定各国定义 OOS 女孩并估计其人口规模的方法。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,各国通常在行政上将失学女童定义为未在教育部管辖范围内的学校就读的女童,但实践中的定义各不相同。使用国家层面的数据和家庭层面的方法来统计在校女童和失学女童,但在 HPV 疫苗接种 实施和评估过程中,在校女童和失学女童之间的区别常常变得模糊。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调需要采用务实、针对具体情况的估计方法,以通过 HPV 疫苗接种 服务准确识别和更有效地接触 OOS 女孩。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为提高 OOS 女孩计数方法的操作效用提供策略,并在资源有限的环境中扩大 HPV 疫苗接种 计划的覆盖范围。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对访谈和主题分析的依赖限制了研究结果的普遍性。在校女童和失学女童之间的区别往往很模糊,这可能会影响人口估计的准确性。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:要实现 2030 年 15 岁女孩 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 覆盖率达到 90% 的目标,需要有效覆盖失学 (OOS) 女孩,特别是在大多数 疫苗 分娩发生在学校环境中的低收入和中等收入国家 (LMIC)。本研究探讨了各国对 OOS 女孩的定义以及估计该人口规模的策略。方法:2024 年 5 月至 9 月期间,我们对 6 个已建立 HPV 疫苗接种 项目的非洲和亚洲中低收入国家的 32 名 HPV 疫苗 项目利益相关者进行了半结构化深度访谈:柬埔寨、喀麦隆、肯尼亚、马拉维、莫桑比克和乌干达。通过混合归纳演绎主题分析,我们确定了各国定义 OOS 女孩以及计算或估计人口规模的方法。结果:在行政上,各国通常将失学女童定义为未在教育部管辖范围内的学校就读的女童,但在实践中,不同背景下的定义有所不同。国家层面的数据(例如人口普查、入学率)和家庭层面的方法(例如人数)通常用于统计在校女童和离校女童。然而,在 HPV 疫苗接种 实施和评估过程中,在校女孩和 OOS 女孩之间的区别往往很模糊,限制了这些方法的操作效用。为了应对这些挑战,一些国家采取了替代方法,包括使用历史或近似数据进行基于代理的人口估计,以及优先考虑被认为存在离校女童较多的地区。这些替代方法被认为是准确性、可行性和资源限制之间的务实妥协。结论:准确计数 OOS 女孩对于 HPV 疫苗接种 很重要,但在资源有限的环境中可能不可行。务实、针对具体情况的估计方法可以提供一种可行的方法,通过 HPV 疫苗接种 服务更有效地识别和接触 OOS 女孩。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探讨各国对失学 (OOS) 女童的定义以及估算中低收入国家 (LMIC) 女童人口规模的策略,以应对在 2030 年实现 15 岁女童 HPV 疫苗接种 覆盖率 90% 的目标方面所面临的挑战。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2024 年 5 月至 9 月期间对来自 6 个非洲和亚洲中低收入国家(柬埔寨、喀麦隆、肯尼亚、马拉维、莫桑比克和乌干达)的 32 名 HPV 疫苗 项目利益相关者进行了半结构化深入访谈。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用半结构化深入访谈和混合归纳演绎主题分析来确定各国定义 OOS 女孩并估计其人口规模的方法。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究发现,各国通常在行政上将失学女童定义为未在教育部管辖范围内的学校就读的女童,但实践中的定义各不相同。使用国家层面的数据和家庭层面的方法来统计在校女童和失学女童,但在 HPV 疫苗接种 实施和评估过程中,在校女童和失学女童之间的区别常常变得模糊。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调需要采用务实、针对具体情况的估计方法,以通过 HPV 疫苗接种 服务准确识别和更有效地接触 OOS 女孩。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为提高 OOS 女孩计数方法的操作效用提供策略,并在资源有限的环境中扩大 HPV 疫苗接种 计划的覆盖范围。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究对访谈和主题分析的依赖限制了研究结果的普遍性。在校女童和失学女童之间的区别往往很模糊,这可能会影响人口估计的准确性。

papers.title: Assessment of natural killer cell activity in HPV-infected women - a cross-sectional study.
papers.abstract: Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infections, particularly high-risk oncogenic types, are linked to cervical and other anogenital cancers. Natural killer (NK) cells play a vital role in the innate immune response, identifying and eliminating virus-infected cells without prior sensitization. Material and methods: This study compares serum NK cell activity in women with oncogenic HPV infections and HPV-negative controls. Understanding differences in NK cell activity may provide insights into HPV clearance mechanisms and potential immunotherapeutic targets. Methods: A prospective cohort study was conducted at Gaziantep University Hospital, enrolling patients over 12 months. Participants were categorized based on HPV status, and blood samples were analyzed to quantitatively assess serum NK cell activity using an ELISA-based assay. Results: Among 82 women, 20 tested positive for HPV 16/18, 35 had other high-risk oncogenic HPV types, and 27 were HPV negative. NK cell activity did not significantly differ between HPV 16/18 and other high-risk HPV groups (p = 0.544). However, the HPV-negative group had significantly higher NK cell activity than both HPV-positive groups (p = 0.001 and p = 0.002). Conclusions: Reduced NK cell activity may contribute to persistent oncogenic HPV infections. These findings suggest a potential role for NK cell-modulating therapies to enhance HPV clearance.

papers.title_zh: HPV 感染女性自然杀伤细胞活性的评估——一项横断面研究。
papers.source_body_en: Objectives: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infections, particularly high-risk oncogenic types, are linked to cervical and other anogenital cancers. Natural killer (NK) cells play a vital role in the innate immune response, identifying and eliminating virus-infected cells without prior sensitization. Material and methods: This study compares serum NK cell activity in women with oncogenic HPV infections and HPV-negative controls. Understanding differences in NK cell activity may provide insights into HPV clearance mechanisms and potential immunotherapeutic targets. Methods: A prospective cohort study was conducted at Gaziantep University Hospital, enrolling patients over 12 months. Participants were categorized based on HPV status, and blood samples were analyzed to quantitatively assess serum NK cell activity using an ELISA-based assay. Results: Among 82 women, 20 tested positive for HPV 16/18, 35 had other high-risk oncogenic HPV types, and 27 were HPV negative. NK cell activity did not significantly differ between HPV 16/18 and other high-risk HPV groups (p = 0.544). However, the HPV-negative group had significantly higher NK cell activity than both HPV-positive groups (p = 0.001 and p = 0.002). Conclusions: Reduced NK cell activity may contribute to persistent oncogenic HPV infections. These findings suggest a potential role for NK cell-modulating therapies to enhance HPV clearance.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 感染,尤其是高风险致癌类型,与宫颈癌和其他肛门生殖器癌有关。自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞在先天 免疫应答 中发挥着至关重要的作用,无需事先致敏即可识别并消除病毒感染的细胞。材料和方法:本研究比较了致癌 HPV 感染女性和 HPV 阴性对照女性的血清 NK 细胞活性。了解 NK 细胞活性的差异可能有助于深入了解 HPV 清除机制和潜在的免疫治疗靶点。方法:在加济安泰普大学医院进行了一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究,招募了超过 12 个月的患者。根据 HPV 状态对参与者进行分类,并使用基于 ELISA 的检测分析血液样本以定量评估血清 NK 细胞活性。结果:在 82 名女性中,20 名 HPV 16/18 检测呈阳性,35 名患有其他高危致癌 HPV 类型,27 名 HPV 阴性。HPV 16/18 和其他 高危型HPV 组之间的 NK 细胞活性没有显着差异 (p = 0.544)。然而,HPV 阴性组的 NK 细胞活性显着高于 HPV 阳性组(p = 0.001 和 p = 0.002)。结论:NK 细胞活性降低可能导致持续致癌 HPV 感染。这些发现表明 NK 细胞调节疗法在增强 HPV 清除方面具有潜在作用。

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Friday, October 30, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Cancer High-risk HPV common among asymptomatic rural Ugandan women by October 26, 2026 in Cancer Reading Time: 3 mins read 0 High-risk HPV common among asymptomatic rural Ugandan women Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram A cross-sectional study of 7,126 women aged 30–49 years in rural Uganda found that 1,800, or 25.3%, tested positive for high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV). Among the positive women with complete genotype data, infections outside the HPV16 and HPV18 groups were common, while a comparison of genotype groups with clinical assessment found no statistically significant relationship with visual inspection with acetic acid (VIA) outcome. The study focused on asymptomatic women who self-collected vaginal samples for testing with the GeneXpert HPV assay. The investigators recorded the presence or absence of specific hrHPV genotypes and used the results to describe genotype distribution in this rural population. All hrHPV-positive participants were invited to receive visual assessment for treatment, with or without VIA, and were treated according to the assessment. No histopathology was performed, so the clinical observations were not accompanied by a histological characterization of cervical lesions. Complete genotype information was available for 1,422 of the 1,800 hrHPV-positive participants. The largest individual genotype group was HPV31/33/35/52/58, detected in 324 women, or 22.8% of those with complete results. Multiple genotypes were the most frequent category, occurring in 397 women, or 27.9%. The remaining distribution consisted of HPV39/56/66/68 in 243 women, or 17.1%; HPV16 in 183, or 12.9%; HPV18/45 in 161, or 11.3%; and HPV51/59 in 114, or 8.0%. These figures show that the detected infections were not confined to HPV16 and HPV18 and that multiple hrHPV genotypes were frequently present. Discover more Book a Checkup Support Causes cancers Cancer Find Cancer Care Of the 1,121 hrHPV-positive women who underwent VIA, irrespective of genotype, 159, or 14.2%, had a positive inspection. Eight women, equal to 0.7% of those inspected, were identified as having cervical cancer. Six of these women were positive for HPV31/33/35/52/58, with three also positive for HPV16, HPV51/59, or HPV39/56/66/68. One woman was positive for HPV18/45, and one was HPV16-positive with an unknown additional genotype. The analysis found no statistically significant relationship between genotype and VIA outcome, meaning the study did not establish a statistical association between the genotype categories and the result of the inspection in the population examined. The findings support the authors’ conclusion that the study population had a high prevalence of non-16/18 hrHPV and that extended genotyping may be relevant to managing women at risk for cervical cancer in Uganda. The eight cervical cancers were identified within the smaller group of hrHPV-positive women who underwent VIA; the figures therefore describe findings in that clinical subgroup and should not be read as population-wide cervical-cancer incidence or direct estimates of genotype-specific risk. The authors call for additional research on the possible role of HPV31/33/35/52/58 in cervical carcinogenesis and on whether available vaccines protect the population against the broader range of hrHPV genotypes found in the study. Among women with ASC-H or HSIL cytology, HPV16-positive individuals carried the heaviest burden of both precancerous lesions and invasive squamous cell carcinoma, while the two cases of adenocarcinoma in situ in the cohort both occurred in the small group positive for HPV18/45. Crucially, when the researchers adjusted for genotype, neither age nor menopausal status remained independently associated with the risk of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or worse, despite clear differences in the unadjusted data. The study, conducted at the Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University in Shijiazhuang, drew on 511 women recorded in the hospital’s ThinPrep cytology database between January 2021 and February 2024 with cytological results of atypical squamous cells, cannot exclude high-grade lesion, or high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion. After excluding 181 women for reasons including missing Aptima HPV testing, absent biopsy or histopathological diagnosis, prior hysterectomy or malignancy, previous pelvic radiotherapy or chemotherapy, and autoimmune disease, 330 women aged 20 to 84 years remained for analysis. All had undergone the Aptima HPV assay, which detects transcriptionally active E6/E7 messenger RNA from 14 high-risk HPV types, followed by colposcopy-guided biopsy and histopathological examination interpreted by two experienced gynecological pathologists. Discover more Risk Uninterruptible power supplies Applied science journals The molecular distinction underlying the assay matters for interpreting the findings. Unlike DNA-based HPV tests, the Aptima assay detects E6/E7 mRNA, the transcripts of the viral oncogenes that drive malignant transformation, which the authors note offers higher specificity for clinically significant lesions. Positive specimens were further genotyped into three categories: HPV16, HPV18/45, and a pooled group of the other 11 high-risk types. Because the genotype assay cannot distinguish HPV18 from HPV45 or establish co-infection, the HPV18/45 category is inherently composite, a limitation that shaped some of the study’s most tentative conclusions. Discover more Find an OBGYN Book Lab Tests risk Get Risk Software The overall burden of disease in this high-risk cytology population was substantial. Histopathology revealed precancerous lesions, defined as CIN2, CIN3, or adenocarcinoma in situ, in 38.2 percent of the women, and malignant lesions, squamous cell carcinoma or adenocarcinoma, in 24.5 percent. Overall high-risk HPV positivity was 82.1 percent, rising from 70.4 percent among women with ASC-H cytology to 94.4 percent among those with HSIL cytology. The distribution of outcomes also differed significantly between the two cytology categories: 38.5 percent of HSIL cases harbored malignant lesions compared with 11.2 percent of ASC-H cases. Genotype stratification revealed a striking pattern. HPV16 was the dominant genotype, detected in 42.1 percent of the cohort, and HPV16-positive women showed the highest proportions of CIN3, at 38.8 percent, and squamous cell carcinoma, at 41.7 percent. Women positive for the other 11 high-risk types, who made up 36.1 percent of the sample, had a CIN2/3 prevalence of 44.5 percent, statistically comparable to the 43.9 percent seen in the HPV16 group. By contrast, among the 59 women who tested negative for high-risk HPV, benign findings predominated, with normal histology accounting for 59.3 percent of cases and a CIN2/3 prevalence of only 13.6 percent. The glandular findings, though suggestive, rest on very thin numbers. Only 13 women were HPV18/45-positive, and both adenocarcinoma in situ cases in the entire cohort occurred in this group, yielding a group-level prevalence of 15.4 percent that differed significantly from the other genotype groups. An exploratory multivariable analysis linked HPV18/45 positivity to AIS or adenocarcinoma with an odds ratio of 15.60, but the confidence interval stretched from 1.42 to 171.32, reflecting just two events. The authors explicitly frame this as hypothesis-generating and caution that it does not support genotype-specific diagnostic or interventional recommendations until confirmed in larger cohorts. Age and menopausal status told a more nuanced story. In unadjusted analyses, CIN2/3 prevalence fell steadily with advancing age, from 50.6 percent among women aged 25 to 34 to 12.5 percent among those 65 and older, while squamous cell carcinoma prevalence climbed from 8.6 percent to 58.3 percent across the same span. Premenopausal women had significantly higher CIN2/3 prevalence than postmenopausal women, 44.1 percent versus 21.3 percent, whereas postmenopausal women had far higher SCC prevalence, 45.7 percent versus 14.0 percent. Exploratory sensitivity analyses using alternative age cut-offs at 30, 40, 50, and 60 years showed broadly consistent patterns, though the authors note these P values were not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Discover more See an OB-GYN Find Cancer Care Cancer Support Causes Book a Checkup Yet when all three variables entered a multivariable logistic regression model simultaneously, the picture changed. HPV16 positivity carried an adjusted odds ratio of 23.79 for CIN2 or worse, HPV18/45 an odds ratio of 5.51, and the other 11 high-risk types an odds ratio of 4.26, all relative to HPV-negative women. Age, modeled as a continuous variable, and menopausal status showed no significant independent association. The authors report that variance inflation factors of 2.35 and 2.37 indicated no problematic multicollinearity between the correlated age and menopause variables, allowing both to be retained as prespecified covariates. Secondary models reinforced the genotype signal: younger age, HPV16, and the other high-risk types independently predicted CIN2/3, while increasing age and HPV16 independently predicted squamous cell carcinoma. One clinically consequential finding concerns the HPV-negative minority. Among the 59 women with high-grade cytology but negative Aptima results, histopathology still identified squamous HSIL or worse in 12 women, 20.3 percent, and one glandular lesion, for an overall prevalence of clinically significant disease of 22.0 percent. Among the nine HPV-negative women with HSIL cytology specifically, six, or 66.7 percent, were confirmed to have CIN2 or worse. The authors propose possible explanations, including inadequate sampling, E6/E7 mRNA expression below the assay’s detection threshold, infection with genotypes outside the assay’s target panel, or persistence of established lesions after viral clearance, but they emphasize that none of these mechanisms were directly evaluated and remain hypothetical. Their conclusion is that a negative HPV result must not override high-grade cytology, and that colposcopy with targeted biopsy remains mandatory for this population regardless of molecular status. The authors acknowledge the constraints of their design. The retrospective, single-center structure limits generalizability, and requiring both Aptima testing and histopathological confirmation may have preferentially selected women with more concerning clinical findings, a selection and verification bias that could inflate lesion prevalence. Excisional or surgical specimens were available for 47.0 percent of participants, and while the highest grade across all specimens defined the final diagnosis, reliance on biopsy alone in the remainder may have underestimated CIN2+ lesions. Centralized rereview of slides was not performed, leaving some interobserver variability unquantified. With these caveats in place, the study’s central message stands on firmer ground: in women whose cytology already signals high-grade disease, the active viral genotype, above all HPV16, refines immediate histopathological risk, while age and menopause, though visible in crude comparisons, add little once genotype is accounted for. Among women with ASC-H or HSIL cytology, HPV16-positive individuals carried the heaviest burden of both precancerous lesions and invasive squamous cell carcinoma, while the two cases of adenocarcinoma in situ in the cohort both occurred in the small group positive for HPV18/45. Crucially, when the researchers adjusted for genotype, neither age nor menopausal status remained independently associated with the risk of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 or worse, despite clear differences in the unadjusted data. The study, conducted at the Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University in Shijiazhuang, drew on 511 women recorded in the hospital’s ThinPrep cytology database between January 2021 and February 2024 with cytological results of atypical squamous cells, cannot exclude high-grade lesion, or high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion. After excluding 181 women for reasons including missing Aptima HPV testing, absent biopsy or histopathological diagnosis, prior hysterectomy or malignancy, previous pelvic radiotherapy or chemotherapy, and autoimmune disease, 330 women aged 20 to 84 years remained for analysis. All had undergone the Aptima HPV assay, which detects transcriptionally active E6/E7 messenger RNA from 14 high-risk HPV types, followed by colposcopy-guided biopsy and histopathological examination interpreted by two experienced gynecological pathologists. Discover more Risk Uninterruptible power supplies Applied science journals The molecular distinction underlying the assay matters for interpreting the findings. Unlike DNA-based HPV tests, the Aptima assay detects E6/E7 mRNA, the transcripts of the viral oncogenes that drive malignant transformation, which the authors note offers higher specificity for clinically significant lesions. Positive specimens were further genotyped into three categories: HPV16, HPV18/45, and a pooled group of the other 11 high-risk types. Because the genotype assay cannot distinguish HPV18 from HPV45 or establish co-infection, the HPV18/45 category is inherently composite, a limitation that shaped some of the study’s most tentative conclusions. Discover more Find an OBGYN Book Lab Tests risk Get Risk Software The overall burden of disease in this high-risk cytology population was substantial. Histopathology revealed precancerous lesions, defined as CIN2, CIN3, or adenocarcinoma in situ, in 38.2 percent of the women, and malignant lesions, squamous cell carcinoma or adenocarcinoma, in 24.5 percent. Overall high-risk HPV positivity was 82.1 percent, rising from 70.4 percent among women with ASC-H cytology to 94.4 percent among those with HSIL cytology. The distribution of outcomes also differed significantly between the two cytology categories: 38.5 percent of HSIL cases harbored malignant lesions compared with 11.2 percent of ASC-H cases. Genotype stratification revealed a striking pattern. HPV16 was the dominant genotype, detected in 42.1 percent of the cohort, and HPV16-positive women showed the highest proportions of CIN3, at 38.8 percent, and squamous cell carcinoma, at 41.7 percent. Women positive for the other 11 high-risk types, who made up 36.1 percent of the sample, had a CIN2/3 prevalence of 44.5 percent, statistically comparable to the 43.9 percent seen in the HPV16 group. By contrast, among the 59 women who tested negative for high-risk HPV, benign findings predominated, with normal histology accounting for 59.3 percent of cases and a CIN2/3 prevalence of only 13.6 percent. The glandular findings, though suggestive, rest on very thin numbers. Only 13 women were HPV18/45-positive, and both adenocarcinoma in situ cases in the entire cohort occurred in this group, yielding a group-level prevalence of 15.4 percent that differed significantly from the other genotype groups. An exploratory multivariable analysis linked HPV18/45 positivity to AIS or adenocarcinoma with an odds ratio of 15.60, but the confidence interval stretched from 1.42 to 171.32, reflecting just two events. The authors explicitly frame this as hypothesis-generating and caution that it does not support genotype-specific diagnostic or interventional recommendations until confirmed in larger cohorts. Age and menopausal status told a more nuanced story. In unadjusted analyses, CIN2/3 prevalence fell steadily with advancing age, from 50.6 percent among women aged 25 to 34 to 12.5 percent among those 65 and older, while squamous cell carcinoma prevalence climbed from 8.6 percent to 58.3 percent across the same span. Premenopausal women had significantly higher CIN2/3 prevalence than postmenopausal women, 44.1 percent versus 21.3 percent, whereas postmenopausal women had far higher SCC prevalence, 45.7 percent versus 14.0 percent. Exploratory sensitivity analyses using alternative age cut-offs at 30, 40, 50, and 60 years showed broadly consistent patterns, though the authors note these P values were not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Discover more See an OB-GYN Find Cancer Care Cancer Support Causes Book a Checkup Yet when all three variables entered a multivariable logistic regression model simultaneously, the picture changed. HPV16 positivity carried an adjusted odds ratio of 23.79 for CIN2 or worse, HPV18/45 an odds ratio of 5.51, and the other 11 high-risk types an odds ratio of 4.26, all relative to HPV-negative women. Age, modeled as a continuous variable, and menopausal status showed no significant independent association. The authors report that variance inflation factors of 2.35 and 2.37 indicated no problematic multicollinearity between the correlated age and menopause variables, allowing both to be retained as prespecified covariates. Secondary models reinforced the genotype signal: younger age, HPV16, and the other high-risk types independently predicted CIN2/3, while increasing age and HPV16 independently predicted squamous cell carcinoma. One clinically consequential finding concerns the HPV-negative minority. Among the 59 women with high-grade cytology but negative Aptima results, histopathology still identified squamous HSIL or worse in 12 women, 20.3 percent, and one glandular lesion, for an overall prevalence of clinically significant disease of 22.0 percent. Among the nine HPV-negative women with HSIL cytology specifically, six, or 66.7 percent, were confirmed to have CIN2 or worse. The authors propose possible explanations, including inadequate sampling, E6/E7 mRNA expression below the assay’s detection threshold, infection with genotypes outside the assay’s target panel, or persistence of established lesions after viral clearance, but they emphasize that none of these mechanisms were directly evaluated and remain hypothetical. Their conclusion is that a negative HPV result must not override high-grade cytology, and that colposcopy with targeted biopsy remains mandatory for this population regardless of molecular status. The authors acknowledge the constraints of their design. The retrospective, single-center structure limits generalizability, and requiring both Aptima testing and histopathological confirmation may have preferentially selected women with more concerning clinical findings, a selection and verification bias that could inflate lesion prevalence. Excisional or surgical specimens were available for 47.0 percent of participants, and while the highest grade across all specimens defined the final diagnosis, reliance on biopsy alone in the remainder may have underestimated CIN2+ lesions. Centralized rereview of slides was not performed, leaving some interobserver variability unquantified. With these caveats in place, the study’s central message stands on firmer ground: in women whose cytology already signals high-grade disease, the active viral genotype, above all HPV16, refines immediate histopathological risk, while age and menopause, though visible in crude comparisons, add little once genotype is accounted for. analysis.brief_en: A study published on October 27, 2026, by Bioengineer.org analyzed 511 women with high-grade cervical cytology results from January 2021 to February 2024 at the Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University in Shijiazhuang. The research found that HPV16 was the dominant genotype, detected in 42.1% of the cohort, and was associated with the highest cancer risk, with 38.8% of HPV16-positive women having CIN3 and 41.7% having squamous cell carcinoma. HPV16-positive individuals also carried the heaviest burden of both precancerous and malignant lesions. The study excluded 181 women due to missing data or other factors, leaving 330 for analysis. While the findings suggest a strong link between HPV16 and cervical cancer, the authors emphasize that these results are hypothesis-generating and require validation in larger cohorts. They also note limitations in the assay, such as the inability to distinguish between HPV18 and HPV45, and caution against making genotype-specific recommendations without further evidence.

news.content_zh: Bioengineer.org 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日发表的一项研究分析了 2021 年 1 月至 2024 年 2 月在石家庄河北医科大学第二医院获得高级别宫颈细胞学结果的 511 名女性。研究发现,HPV16 是主要基因型,在 42.1% 的 队列研究 中检测到,并且与最高的癌症风险相关,其中 38.8% 的 HPV16 阳性女性患有 CIN3,41.7% 患有鳞状细胞癌。HPV16 阳性个体也承受着最重的癌前病变和恶性病变负担。由于数据缺失或其他因素,该研究排除了 181 名女性,留下 330 名女性进行分析。虽然研究结果表明 HPV16 和 宫颈癌 之间存在密切联系,但作者强调,这些结果只是假设生成,需要在更大的 队列研究 中进行验证。他们还指出了该检测的局限性,例如无法区分 HPV18 和 HPV45,并警告不要在没有进一步证据的情况下提出针对基因型的建议。

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Friday, October 30, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Technology Recombinant HPV16 E7 vaccine plus CD137 agonism clears tumors in mice by October 27, 2026 in Technology Reading Time: 5 mins read 0 Recombinant HPV16 E7 vaccine plus CD137 agonism clears tumors in mice Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram A therapeutic vaccine engineered from the HPV16 E7 oncoprotein, delivered as a single recombinant protein rather than a mixture of synthetic peptides, has shown strong antitumor activity in mice, and its effect was substantially amplified when paired with an antibody that stimulates the co-stimulatory receptor 4-1BB, also known as CD137. The work, with Shisong Jiang as lead contact, offers a preclinical template for therapeutic HPV vaccination that avoids delivering intact, oncogenically active viral protein. The rationale for a new antigen format stems from a persistent gap in HPV medicine. Prophylactic vaccines targeting the L1 capsid protein generate neutralizing antibodies and prevent new infections, but they offer no therapeutic benefit to people who already carry established HPV-related lesions or cancers. HPV16 and HPV18 account for roughly 70 percent of cervical cancer cases, and persistent infection with high-risk HPV types remains the leading cause of cervical and other anogenital malignancies. No therapeutic vaccine has been approved for patients with premalignant lesions or HPV-positive tumors, although preclinical and clinical efforts targeting the viral oncogenic proteins E6 and E7 have shown promise, particularly those that harness cell-mediated immunity. Existing therapeutic approaches each carry drawbacks. DNA vaccines encoding the oncoproteins can activate cell-mediated immunity but raise safety concerns because E6 and E7 drive tumorigenesis. Wild-type protein vaccines cross-present antigen inefficiently, and epitope-based vaccines are restricted to patients with matching HLA types. Overlapping synthetic peptide and long synthetic peptide vaccines have achieved promising immunogenicity and clinical activity while using non-oncogenic peptide fragments, but peptide pools present practical problems: individual peptides are processed unevenly by antigen-presenting cells, some enter cells and access MHC molecules poorly, and synthesizing and quality-controlling many separate peptides adds regulatory complexity. The platform tested here, called a recombinant overlapping peptide or ROP vaccine, addresses those limitations by genetically concatenating overlapping peptide fragments spanning the full wild-type protein sequence into a single recombinant construct. For HPV16 E7, a 98-amino-acid oncoprotein, the team divided the sequence into 35-amino-acid fragments with 10-amino-acid overlaps and joined them with LRMK linker motifs. The 35-residue length was chosen because long peptides are efficiently internalized by professional antigen-presenting cells and require intracellular processing before presentation, while the 10-residue overlap exceeds the typical length of minimal CD8 T cell epitopes, ensuring that every potential epitope is retained in at least one fragment. The LRMK motif serves as a cleavage site for cathepsin S, a protease abundantly expressed in professional antigen-presenting cells, so cleavage within endosomal compartments releases fragments for MHC loading. Safety is built into the design. Wild-type E7 contains conserved regions critical for oncogenic activity: the N-terminal CR1 and CR2 domains, including the LXCXE motif that binds the retinoblastoma tumor suppressor family, and the C-terminal CR3 zinc-binding motif that supports structural stability and dimerization. These activities depend on the tertiary structure and intracellular expression of the full-length protein. Because ROP-E7 is delivered as an exogenous recombinant protein that is rapidly proteolyzed into short linear epitopes lacking higher-order structure, the functional domains required for pRb binding and zinc-dependent dimerization cannot be reconstituted. In silico analysis using the Immune Epitope Database suggested the construct may generate a broader array of potential T cell epitopes than wild-type E7, although the authors note that computational prediction does not directly assess epitope usage in vivo. Immunization experiments in C57BL/6 mice bore out the design intent. Three subcutaneous doses of MPLA-adjuvanted ROP-E7, given at 14-day intervals, induced significantly stronger cellular responses than the same regimen with wild-type E7, measured by interferon-gamma ELISPOT after ex vivo restimulation with purified WT-E7 protein. Flow cytometry showed higher proportions of activated CD4 and CD8 T cells, and MHC class I tetramer staining for the immunodominant H-2Db-restricted E7 epitope RAHYNIVTF revealed greater expansion of E7-specific CD8 T cells in the ROP-E7 group. In a separate cohort immunized at 7-day intervals, splenocytes from ROP-E7-vaccinated mice lysed HPV16 E7-expressing TC-1 tumor cells far more effectively than splenocytes from controls. Therapeutic efficacy was tested in the TC-1 model, in which mice were inoculated subcutaneously with 2 x 10^5 TC-1 cells on day 0 and vaccination began on day 5, when tumors were generally not yet palpable or only minimally palpable. The authors emphasize that this was an early-treatment setting rather than a model of large established tumors. Both vaccines inhibited tumor growth and prolonged survival relative to PBS and MPLA controls, with control tumors reaching roughly 1,500 cubic millimeters by day 22, WT-E7-treated tumors averaging about 700 cubic millimeters, and ROP-E7-treated tumors numerically smaller at under 500 cubic millimeters. The differences between the two vaccine groups did not reach statistical significance, so superiority of ROP-E7 over WT-E7 could not be formally established on these endpoints, though the trend prompted deeper analysis of the tumor immune microenvironment. That analysis combined bulk RNA sequencing with two immune deconvolution algorithms, mMCP-counter and Digital Cell Quantification, plus flow cytometry of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. Tumors from ROP-E7-treated mice carried stronger T cell and CD8 T cell transcriptional signatures and significantly more CD8 tetramer-positive T cells than tumors from WT-E7-vaccinated mice, while intratumoral regulatory T cells showed a non-significant trend toward reduction and splenic Treg frequencies were unchanged, indicating that immune modulation was localized to the tumor. DCQ analysis associated ROP-E7 with CD8 effector memory and memory signatures, whereas WT-E7 tumors showed relatively higher CD4 memory and Treg signatures, and PBS control tumors carried higher stromal signatures including endothelial cells and cancer-associated fibroblasts. Combination testing produced the study’s most striking results. Adding anti-PD-1 concurrently with the first vaccination did not improve tumor control over ROP-E7 alone under the dosing and schedule used, which the authors attribute to possible differences in antibody dose and timing relative to vaccine priming, since PD-1 signaling contributes to early CD8 T cell activation and clonal expansion. In contrast, combining ROP-E7 with a relatively low dose of 4-1BB agonistic antibody, which had limited activity as monotherapy, led to complete tumor eradication in the majority of treated mice within the initial 23-day analysis window and a trend toward prolonged survival. Extended follow-up to day 98 revealed the divergence clearly: all 15 ROP-E7 monotherapy mice eventually relapsed, yielding zero complete responses, while 10 of 15 combination-treated mice achieved complete regression and remained tumor-free. Transcriptomics showed the combination increased tumor-associated high endothelial venule signatures, structures that facilitate lymphocyte entry into tumors, and reduced Treg and exhaustion signatures, with tumor-infiltrating CD8 T cells expressing lower levels of PD-1 and LAG-3 than in the monotherapy group. Durability, however, proved incomplete. Four tumor-free combination-treated mice were rechallenged with TC-1 cells on day 98; by day 120 one remained tumor-free while three developed tumors, indicating that long-term immune memory was partially retained but not uniformly protective. A second course of the combination regimen given on day 123 cleared recurrent tumors in two of the three mice with established recurrences, and a single ROP-E7 booster restored strong ex vivo cytotoxic activity in splenocytes from tumor-rejecting mice, showing that functional memory persisted but required antigenic re-stimulation. The authors caution that all findings come from a murine model that does not reproduce the heterogeneity of human HPV-associated malignancies, that safety assessment of 4-1BB agonism was limited to the absence of significant body weight loss despite known dose-dependent hepatotoxicity concerns with systemic agonists, that epitope breadth was inferred computationally rather than mapped experimentally, and that the mechanistic contribution of the LRMK linkers remains to be directly demonstrated. Within those limits, the study supports ROP-based antigen engineering, and its pairing with co-stimulatory immunotherapy, as a candidate strategy for therapeutic HPV vaccination. analysis.time: The study was published on October 27, 2026. The experiments were conducted with mice vaccinated at 14-day intervals starting on day 5, and follow-up extended to day 98.
analysis.location_and_population: The research was conducted in a laboratory setting using C57BL/6 mice as the experimental population.
analysis.event: A therapeutic vaccine composed of a recombinant HPV16 E7 oncoprotein, combined with CD137 agonism, was tested in mice and showed antitumor activity, with some mice achieving complete tumor regression when combined with anti-PD-1 treatment.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The study reported that tumors in mice treated with ROP-E7 were numerically smaller than those treated with wild-type E7, though the difference was not statistically significant. In combination with anti-PD-1, 10 out of 15 mice achieved complete tumor regression, while all 15 mice treated with ROP-E7 alone relapsed. The risk of tumor progression was reduced in the ROP-E7 group, but the study did not report specific case or death counts.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study is in the preclinical phase, with results showing promising therapeutic efficacy in mice. The authors note that the findings are based on in vivo experiments and that the superiority of ROP-E7 over wild-type E7 could not be formally established. The research is ongoing, and further studies are needed to validate these results in humans.

The study highlights the potential of this platform for therapeutic HPV vaccination but emphasizes that the results are preclinical and require further validation in humans. The research addresses the limitations of existing therapeutic approaches, such as safety concerns with wild-type E7 and HLA restrictions with epitope-based vaccines.

elements_zh.event: 由重组 HPV16 E7 癌蛋白组成的治疗剂 疫苗 与 CD137 激动剂相结合,在小鼠中进行了测试,并显示出抗肿瘤活性,当与抗 PD-1 治疗 组合时,一些小鼠实现了肿瘤完全消退。
elements_zh.scale_impact_and_risk: 该研究报告称,用 ROP-E7 治疗的小鼠的肿瘤在数量上比用野生型 E7 治疗的小鼠要小,但差异并不具有统计学意义。与抗 PD-1 联合治疗时,15 只小鼠中有 10 只实现了肿瘤完全消退,而单独使用 ROP-E7 治疗的所有 15 只小鼠均出现肿瘤复发。ROP-E7 组的肿瘤进展风险降低,但该研究没有报告具体病例或死亡人数。
elements_zh.response_status_and_uncertainty: 该研究正处于临床前阶段,结果显示对小鼠有良好的治疗效果。作者指出,这些发现基于体内实验,并且无法正式确定 ROP-E7 相对于野生型 E7 的优越性。该研究正在进行中,需要进一步的研究来在人类身上验证这些结果。

analysis_en.time: The study was published on October 27, 2026. The experiments were conducted with mice vaccinated at 14-day intervals starting on day 5, and follow-up extended to day 98.
analysis_en.location_and_population: The research was conducted in a laboratory setting using C57BL/6 mice as the experimental population.
analysis_en.event: A therapeutic vaccine composed of a recombinant HPV16 E7 oncoprotein, combined with CD137 agonism, was tested in mice and showed antitumor activity, with some mice achieving complete tumor regression when combined with anti-PD-1 treatment.
analysis_en.scale_impact_and_risk: The study reported that tumors in mice treated with ROP-E7 were numerically smaller than those treated with wild-type E7, though the difference was not statistically significant. In combination with anti-PD-1, 10 out of 15 mice achieved complete tumor regression, while all 15 mice treated with ROP-E7 alone relapsed. The risk of tumor progression was reduced in the ROP-E7 group, but the study did not report specific case or death counts.
analysis_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study is in the preclinical phase, with results showing promising therapeutic efficacy in mice. The authors note that the findings are based on in vivo experiments and that the superiority of ROP-E7 over wild-type E7 could not be formally established. The research is ongoing, and further studies are needed to validate these results in humans.

news.title_zh: 重组 HPV16 E7 疫苗 加上 CD137 激动剂可清除小鼠肿瘤 - Bioengineer.org
news.source_body_en: A study published on October 27, 2026, by Bioengineer.org reports that a recombinant HPV16 E7 vaccine, when combined with CD137 agonism, showed antitumor activity in mice. The vaccine, designed as a single recombinant protein with overlapping peptide fragments, was tested in C57BL/6 mice, where it induced stronger cellular immune responses compared to wild-type E7. In a separate cohort, ROP-E7 vaccination led to more effective tumor cell lysis than controls. When combined with anti-PD-1 treatment, 10 out of 15 mice achieved complete tumor regression, though all 15 mice treated with ROP-E7 alone eventually relapsed. The study highlights the potential of this platform for therapeutic HPV vaccination but emphasizes that the results are preclinical and require further validation in humans. The research addresses the limitations of existing therapeutic approaches, such as safety concerns with wild-type E7 and HLA restrictions with epitope-based vaccines.

news.content_title: 除了HPV16、18,这些高危亚型同样值得警惕!
news.content: 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 除了HPV16、18,这些高危亚型同样值得警惕! 2026-10-27 15:55 来源: 孚瑞坦 发布于:福建省 在宫颈癌防控科普中,HPV16、18因与约70%的宫颈癌发病直接相关,始终是公众关注的重点。但高危型人乳头瘤病毒家族不只这2个,部分非HPV16、18型别的流行强度与致癌风险同样不容忽视,在亚洲女性群体中,部分亚型的感染占比甚至高于全球平均水平。除16、18型外,HPV31、33、45、52、58等是临床中检出率较高、致癌潜力明确的核心亚型。 其中,HPV52、58型是国内女性感染率排名靠前的高危亚型。国内多项流行病学调查显示,二者在宫颈病变人群中的检出占比显著高于欧美人群。这两种亚型均可诱导宫颈鳞状上皮细胞发生异型增生,持续感染状态下会推动病变从低级别向高级别进展,最终存在恶变可能,是我国宫颈癌防控中不可忽视的本土流行亚型。 HPV31、33、45型则是全球公认的高致癌风险亚型,三者合计贡献了10%~15%的宫颈癌病例。HPV31的致癌活性仅次于16、18型,可累及宫颈、阴道、外阴等多个部位;HPV33型与宫颈鳞癌、腺癌的发生均存在关联;HPV45型则在宫颈腺癌病例中占比相对突出。 此外,HPV35、39、51、56、59、68等亚型同样属于高危范畴,虽整体流行度偏低,但一旦形成持续感染,仍存在引发宫颈上皮内瘤变的潜在风险,筛查发现阳性后同样需要规范随访。 研究数据显示,80%以上的女性一生中会感染至少一种高危型HPV,其中多数为一过性感染,可通过自身免疫系统在1~2年内自行清除。仅有小部分的感染会发展为持续性感染,而高危HPV的持续感染正是宫颈上皮内瘤变(CIN)乃至宫颈癌发生的核心病因。从初次感染到病变进展通常有数年至十余年的时间窗,这一阶段也是无创干预、阻断病程的关键时期。 按照我国子宫颈癌三级规范化防治原则,及时清除高危HPV持续性感染、降低病毒载量,是避免病变进展、减少有创治疗的关键环节。针对高危HPV感染的干预,合规的二类医疗器械可作为重要的辅助手段。 孚瑞坦抗人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)凝胶敷料是经药品监督管理局批准的二类医疗器械(注册证号:桂械注准20232180013),获批适用范围为:阻断生殖道高危人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染,阻止病原微生物定植,用于降低高危人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)载量,防止宫颈病变发生;阻断人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染,阻止皮肤病变,降低物理治疗后尖锐湿疣复发率。 该产品采用IgY生物抗体靶向技术,通过抗HPV-L1-IgY、抗HPV-E6/E7-IgY与抗妇科炎症复合IgY形成抗体协同体系,搭配蛋白膜乳化均聚技术,以改性明胶为纳米载体,可作用于生殖道黏膜部位。 有一项随机对照研究纳入120例高危HPV感染合并CIN患者,结果显示,使用孚瑞坦抗HPV凝胶敷料治疗后,HPV转阴率可达88.33%,疗效优于对照组,同时可有效提升CIN病变转阴比例,相关研究成果已发表于专业医药期刊。[1] 宫颈癌防控离不开定期筛查与规范干预,重视所有高危亚型的感染风险,在合适的窗口期采取合规干预手段,才能更全面地守护女性生殖道健康。 品牌简介 孚瑞坦,专业健康品牌,深耕病毒领域。品牌强国医疗器械行业优选成员单位。现产品体系涵盖HPV、HSV等病毒防治需求。拥有以IgY(卵黄免疫球蛋白)为核心的多项专利,致力于用前沿生物科技,惠及全球亿万家庭。 温馨提示:请仔细阅读产品说明书或者在医务人员的指导下购买和使用。本文旨在健康科普,具体诊疗请遵医嘱。 参考文献: [1]苏玲.孚瑞坦抗人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)凝胶敷料治疗高危HPV感染合并CIN的临床疗效分析[J].中文科技期刊数据库(全文版)医药卫生,2024(5):0186-0189返回搜狐,查看更多 阅读 () 平台声明 该文观点仅代表作者本人,搜狐号系信息发布平台,搜狐仅提供信息存储空间服务。

news.content_original: 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 除了HPV16、18,这些高危亚型同样值得警惕! 2026-10-27 15:55 来源: 孚瑞坦 发布于:福建省 在宫颈癌防控科普中,HPV16、18因与约70%的宫颈癌发病直接相关,始终是公众关注的重点。但高危型人乳头瘤病毒家族不只这2个,部分非HPV16、18型别的流行强度与致癌风险同样不容忽视,在亚洲女性群体中,部分亚型的感染占比甚至高于全球平均水平。除16、18型外,HPV31、33、45、52、58等是临床中检出率较高、致癌潜力明确的核心亚型。 其中,HPV52、58型是国内女性感染率排名靠前的高危亚型。国内多项流行病学调查显示,二者在宫颈病变人群中的检出占比显著高于欧美人群。这两种亚型均可诱导宫颈鳞状上皮细胞发生异型增生,持续感染状态下会推动病变从低级别向高级别进展,最终存在恶变可能,是我国宫颈癌防控中不可忽视的本土流行亚型。 HPV31、33、45型则是全球公认的高致癌风险亚型,三者合计贡献了10%~15%的宫颈癌病例。HPV31的致癌活性仅次于16、18型,可累及宫颈、阴道、外阴等多个部位;HPV33型与宫颈鳞癌、腺癌的发生均存在关联;HPV45型则在宫颈腺癌病例中占比相对突出。 此外,HPV35、39、51、56、59、68等亚型同样属于高危范畴,虽整体流行度偏低,但一旦形成持续感染,仍存在引发宫颈上皮内瘤变的潜在风险,筛查发现阳性后同样需要规范随访。 研究数据显示,80%以上的女性一生中会感染至少一种高危型HPV,其中多数为一过性感染,可通过自身免疫系统在1~2年内自行清除。仅有小部分的感染会发展为持续性感染,而高危HPV的持续感染正是宫颈上皮内瘤变(CIN)乃至宫颈癌发生的核心病因。从初次感染到病变进展通常有数年至十余年的时间窗,这一阶段也是无创干预、阻断病程的关键时期。 按照我国子宫颈癌三级规范化防治原则,及时清除高危HPV持续性感染、降低病毒载量,是避免病变进展、减少有创治疗的关键环节。针对高危HPV感染的干预,合规的二类医疗器械可作为重要的辅助手段。 孚瑞坦抗人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)凝胶敷料是经药品监督管理局批准的二类医疗器械(注册证号:桂械注准20232180013),获批适用范围为:阻断生殖道高危人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染,阻止病原微生物定植,用于降低高危人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)载量,防止宫颈病变发生;阻断人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染,阻止皮肤病变,降低物理治疗后尖锐湿疣复发率。 该产品采用IgY生物抗体靶向技术,通过抗HPV-L1-IgY、抗HPV-E6/E7-IgY与抗妇科炎症复合IgY形成抗体协同体系,搭配蛋白膜乳化均聚技术,以改性明胶为纳米载体,可作用于生殖道黏膜部位。 有一项随机对照研究纳入120例高危HPV感染合并CIN患者,结果显示,使用孚瑞坦抗HPV凝胶敷料治疗后,HPV转阴率可达88.33%,疗效优于对照组,同时可有效提升CIN病变转阴比例,相关研究成果已发表于专业医药期刊。[1] 宫颈癌防控离不开定期筛查与规范干预,重视所有高危亚型的感染风险,在合适的窗口期采取合规干预手段,才能更全面地守护女性生殖道健康。 品牌简介 孚瑞坦,专业健康品牌,深耕病毒领域。品牌强国医疗器械行业优选成员单位。现产品体系涵盖HPV、HSV等病毒防治需求。拥有以IgY(卵黄免疫球蛋白)为核心的多项专利,致力于用前沿生物科技,惠及全球亿万家庭。 温馨提示:请仔细阅读产品说明书或者在医务人员的指导下购买和使用。本文旨在健康科普,具体诊疗请遵医嘱。 参考文献: [1]苏玲.孚瑞坦抗人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)凝胶敷料治疗高危HPV感染合并CIN的临床疗效分析[J].中文科技期刊数据库(全文版)医药卫生,2024(5):0186-0189返回搜狐,查看更多 阅读 () 平台声明 该文观点仅代表作者本人,搜狐号系信息发布平台,搜狐仅提供信息存储空间服务。

HPV18+6混合感染,一边高危一边长疣,该先处理哪个?苏利哲医生科学解答 2026-10-26 16:40 来源: 郑州美中商都医院 链接复制成功 发布于:河南省 查出HPV18高危型阳性,同时又长出了HPV6引发的尖锐湿疣,很多感染者瞬间陷入两难:有人觉得先把可见的疣体烧掉就行,高危型病毒不用急着管;也有人一门心思盯着高危型调理,放任疣体反复扩散,两种极端做法最后都把身体拖进了更被动的局面。郑州美中商都医院苏利哲主任深耕HPV诊疗领域多年,在临床中见过大量这类混合感染的患者,靠单一方向干预,最后反而出现疣体反复复发、高危型悄悄进展的情况。 29岁的张女士就是典型案例,查出HPV18+6混合感染时,外阴已经长出了好几颗明显的疣体,她一开始只想着先把疣体去掉,做了两次激光就觉得治疗完成,完全没管高危型HPV18的后续管理,不到半年疣体就再次复发,复查时还发现宫颈已经出现了CIN1低级别病变。苏利哲主任解释,很多人误以为混合感染要分先后顺序,要么先清疣要么先调高危,其实这是完全错误的思路:HPV6引发的疣体表面附着大量高活性病毒颗粒,持续刺激局部黏膜破损,会让HPV18更容易向宫颈深层上皮定植,加速病变进展;而HPV18的持续感染会不断削弱宫颈局部免疫,反过来又会让HPV6的疣体反复复发,两者互相推动,形成越治越麻烦的恶性循环。 苏利哲主任针对张女士的情况,制定了“同步分层干预”的方案:先精准清除可见疣体和潜伏的亚临床感染灶,同时同步调理宫颈局部免疫,阻断HPV18的持续定植,仅仅6个月后张女士复查,不仅疣体完全清除没有复发,HPV18和HPV6两个亚型也全部实现转阴,宫颈上的低级别病变也彻底逆转。苏利哲主任特别提醒,HPV18+6混合感染从来不存在“谁先谁后”的优先级,同步阻断疣体扩散和高危型病毒进展,才是避免两头出问题的最稳妥路径。返回搜狐,查看更多 HPV18+6混合感染,一边高危一边长疣,该先处理哪个?苏利哲医生科学解答 2026-10-26 16:40 来源: 郑州美中商都医院 链接复制成功 发布于:河南省 查出HPV18高危型阳性,同时又长出了HPV6引发的尖锐湿疣,很多感染者瞬间陷入两难:有人觉得先把可见的疣体烧掉就行,高危型病毒不用急着管;也有人一门心思盯着高危型调理,放任疣体反复扩散,两种极端做法最后都把身体拖进了更被动的局面。郑州美中商都医院苏利哲主任深耕HPV诊疗领域多年,在临床中见过大量这类混合感染的患者,靠单一方向干预,最后反而出现疣体反复复发、高危型悄悄进展的情况。 29岁的张女士就是典型案例,查出HPV18+6混合感染时,外阴已经长出了好几颗明显的疣体,她一开始只想着先把疣体去掉,做了两次激光就觉得治疗完成,完全没管高危型HPV18的后续管理,不到半年疣体就再次复发,复查时还发现宫颈已经出现了CIN1低级别病变。苏利哲主任解释,很多人误以为混合感染要分先后顺序,要么先清疣要么先调高危,其实这是完全错误的思路:HPV6引发的疣体表面附着大量高活性病毒颗粒,持续刺激局部黏膜破损,会让HPV18更容易向宫颈深层上皮定植,加速病变进展;而HPV18的持续感染会不断削弱宫颈局部免疫,反过来又会让HPV6的疣体反复复发,两者互相推动,形成越治越麻烦的恶性循环。 苏利哲主任针对张女士的情况,制定了“同步分层干预”的方案:先精准清除可见疣体和潜伏的亚临床感染灶,同时同步调理宫颈局部免疫,阻断HPV18的持续定植,仅仅6个月后张女士复查,不仅疣体完全清除没有复发,HPV18和HPV6两个亚型也全部实现转阴,宫颈上的低级别病变也彻底逆转。苏利哲主任特别提醒,HPV18+6混合感染从来不存在“谁先谁后”的优先级,同步阻断疣体扩散和高危型病毒进展,才是避免两头出问题的最稳妥路径。返回搜狐,查看更多 news.content: X 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 母婴 健康 历史 军事 美食 更多 文化 星座 专题 游戏 搞笑 动漫 宠物 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 母婴 健康 历史 军事 美食 文化 星座 专题 游戏 搞笑 动漫 宠物 更多 无障碍 关怀版 登录 查出HPV18+CIN1,坚持4个月,为什么医生说别硬等?张振强主任权/威解答 2026-10-26 16:28 来源: 长沙中研医院HPV诊疗 链接复制成功 发布于:湖南省 HPV18型是和HPV16并列的最高危亚型,致病隐蔽性极强,很多人查出合并CIN1低级别病变后,第一反应就是回家硬等,觉得靠自身免疫力就能自然转阴,拖到半年一年再复查也没关系,这恰恰是HPV18感染后最危险的认知误区。 长沙中研皮肤病医院HPV科张振强主任深耕HPV诊疗领域20余年,在临床中见过大量HPV18阳性合并CIN1的患者,硬等半年后复查,病变非但没有消退,反而悄悄进展,甚至直接跳级到CIN2、CIN3的案例。他解释,普通低危型或其他高危亚型引发的CIN1,自然转阴概率确实偏高,但HPV18型的病毒载量上升速度快、对宫颈深层黏膜的侵袭力强,哪怕只是合并低级别病变,也不能照搬“保守观察1年以上”的通用标准,盲目硬等很可能错过最佳干预窗口。 很多患者觉得“CIN1是最轻的病变,根本不用处理”,但张振强主任提醒,HPV18型感染引发的CIN1,有相当一部分病灶藏在宫颈管深处,常规TCT和普通阴道镜很难完全发现,硬等的过程中病毒会持续破坏局部黏膜免疫,原本可以轻松逆转的病变,很可能在几个月内悄悄进展。他接诊过一位27岁的患者,查出HPV18+CIN1后坚持硬等8个月,复查时直接发现颈管内隐匿的高级别病变,原本无需手术的情况,最后不得不做锥切干预。 针对这类患者,张振强主任不会直接建议手术,也不会放任患者盲目硬等,而是采用“精准排查+局部免疫激活”的分层干预方案,先通过精细化检查把藏在褶皱里的隐匿病灶全部找出来,再用中西医结合的方式快速提升宫颈局部的抗病毒能力,很多坚持规范干预4个月的患者,复查时不仅HPV18成功转阴,CIN1病变也完全逆转,不用承受不必要的手术创伤。他特别强调,HPV18合并CIN1从来不是“等等就好”的问题,科学干预远比重度拖延更稳妥。返回搜狐,查看更多 首赞 +1 点赞失败 阅读 () 作者声明 个人观点,仅供参考 平台声明 该文观点仅代表作者本人,搜狐号系信息发布平台,搜狐仅提供信息存储空间服务。 内容举报 by Taboolaby Taboola Sponsored LinksSponsored Links Promoted LinksPromoted Links 你可能会喜欢 A Christmas Train Display Everyone Will Want to Seechristmas Undo Meet The Cat Advent Calendar With A Surprise Every DayGIFTS Undo This Japanese Sharpener Restores Razor-Like Sharpness to Any KnifeSherum Undo Here's The Estimated Walk-In Shower Price in 2026Homebuddy Undo Urologists: 87% of men don't know about this easy trick (start tonight)The Mens Report Undo The Christmas Village Skating Town Breaks All Sales Records in USchristmas Undo 推荐阅读 闽超决赛即将上演,厦门白鹭体育场,终于等来“闽超”的巅峰对决 精选所见所闻 · 10-15 03:16 今晚19:00!全胜厦门队VS翻盘福州队,闽超终极一战,冠军归谁? news.content_original: X 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 母婴 健康 历史 军事 美食 更多 文化 星座 专题 游戏 搞笑 动漫 宠物 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 母婴 健康 历史 军事 美食 文化 星座 专题 游戏 搞笑 动漫 宠物 更多 无障碍 关怀版 登录 查出HPV18+CIN1,坚持4个月,为什么医生说别硬等?张振强主任权/威解答 2026-10-26 16:28 来源: 长沙中研医院HPV诊疗 链接复制成功 发布于:湖南省 HPV18型是和HPV16并列的最高危亚型,致病隐蔽性极强,很多人查出合并CIN1低级别病变后,第一反应就是回家硬等,觉得靠自身免疫力就能自然转阴,拖到半年一年再复查也没关系,这恰恰是HPV18感染后最危险的认知误区。 长沙中研皮肤病医院HPV科张振强主任深耕HPV诊疗领域20余年,在临床中见过大量HPV18阳性合并CIN1的患者,硬等半年后复查,病变非但没有消退,反而悄悄进展,甚至直接跳级到CIN2、CIN3的案例。他解释,普通低危型或其他高危亚型引发的CIN1,自然转阴概率确实偏高,但HPV18型的病毒载量上升速度快、对宫颈深层黏膜的侵袭力强,哪怕只是合并低级别病变,也不能照搬“保守观察1年以上”的通用标准,盲目硬等很可能错过最佳干预窗口。 很多患者觉得“CIN1是最轻的病变,根本不用处理”,但张振强主任提醒,HPV18型感染引发的CIN1,有相当一部分病灶藏在宫颈管深处,常规TCT和普通阴道镜很难完全发现,硬等的过程中病毒会持续破坏局部黏膜免疫,原本可以轻松逆转的病变,很可能在几个月内悄悄进展。他接诊过一位27岁的患者,查出HPV18+CIN1后坚持硬等8个月,复查时直接发现颈管内隐匿的高级别病变,原本无需手术的情况,最后不得不做锥切干预。 针对这类患者,张振强主任不会直接建议手术,也不会放任患者盲目硬等,而是采用“精准排查+局部免疫激活”的分层干预方案,先通过精细化检查把藏在褶皱里的隐匿病灶全部找出来,再用中西医结合的方式快速提升宫颈局部的抗病毒能力,很多坚持规范干预4个月的患者,复查时不仅HPV18成功转阴,CIN1病变也完全逆转,不用承受不必要的手术创伤。他特别强调,HPV18合并CIN1从来不是“等等就好”的问题,科学干预远比重度拖延更稳妥。返回搜狐,查看更多 首赞 +1 点赞失败 阅读 () 作者声明 个人观点,仅供参考 平台声明 该文观点仅代表作者本人,搜狐号系信息发布平台,搜狐仅提供信息存储空间服务。 内容举报 by Taboolaby Taboola Sponsored LinksSponsored Links Promoted LinksPromoted Links 你可能会喜欢 A Christmas Train Display Everyone Will Want to Seechristmas Undo Meet The Cat Advent Calendar With A Surprise Every DayGIFTS Undo This Japanese Sharpener Restores Razor-Like Sharpness to Any KnifeSherum Undo Here's The Estimated Walk-In Shower Price in 2026Homebuddy Undo Urologists: 87% of men don't know about this easy trick (start tonight)The Mens Report Undo The Christmas Village Skating Town Breaks All Sales Records in USchristmas Undo 推荐阅读 闽超决赛即将上演,厦门白鹭体育场,终于等来“闽超”的巅峰对决 精选所见所闻 · 10-15 03:16 今晚19:00!全胜厦门队VS翻盘福州队,闽超终极一战,冠军归谁? source_language_evidence.brief_en: X 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 母婴 健康 历史 军事 美食 更多 文化 星座 专题 游戏 搞笑 动漫 宠物 新闻 体育 汽车 房产 旅游 教育 时尚 科技 财经 娱乐 母婴 健康 历史 军事 美食 文化 星座 专题 游戏 搞笑 动漫 宠物 更多 无障碍 关怀版 登录 查出HPV18+CIN1,坚持4个月,为什么医生说别硬等?张振强主任权/威解答 2026-10-26 16:28 来源: 长沙中研医院HPV诊疗 链接复制成功 发布于:湖南省 HPV18型是和HPV16并列的最高危亚型,致病隐蔽性极强,很多人查出合并CIN1低级别病变后,第一反应就是回家硬等,觉得靠自身免疫力就能自然转阴,拖到半年一年再复查也没关系,这恰恰是HPV18感染后最危险的认知误区。 长沙中研皮肤病医院HPV科张振强主任深耕HPV诊疗领域20余年,在临床中见过大量HPV18阳性合并CIN1的患者,硬等半年后复查,病变非但没有消退,反而悄悄进展,甚至直接跳级到CIN2、CIN3的案例。他解释,普通低危型或其他高危亚型引发的CIN1,自然转阴概率确实偏高,但HPV18型的病毒载量上升速度快、对宫颈深层黏膜的侵袭力强,哪怕只是合并低级别病变,也不能照搬“保守观察1年以上”的通用标准,盲目硬等很可能错过最佳干预窗口。 很多患者觉得“CIN1是最轻的病变,根本不用处理”,但张振强主任提醒,HPV18型感染引发的CIN1,有相当一部分病灶藏在宫颈管深处,常规TCT和普通阴道镜很难完全发现,硬等的过程中病毒会持续破坏局部黏膜免疫,原本可以轻松逆转的病变,很可能在几个月内悄悄进展。他接诊过一位27岁的患者,查出HPV18+CIN1后坚持硬等8个月,复查时直接发现颈管内隐匿的高级别病变,原本无需手术的情况,最后不得不做锥切干预。 针对这类患者,张振强主任不会直接建议手术,也不会放任患者盲目硬等,而是采用“精准排查+局部免疫激活”的分层干预方案,先通过精细化检查把藏在褶皱里的隐匿病灶全部找出来,再用中西医结合的方式快速提升宫颈局部的抗病毒能力,很多坚持规范干预4个月的患者,复查时不仅HPV18成功转阴,CIN1病变也完全逆转,不用承受不必要的手术创伤。他特别强调,HPV18合并CIN1从来不是“等等就好”的问题,科学干预远比重度拖延更稳妥。返回搜狐,查看更多 首赞 +1 点赞失败 阅读 () 作者声明 个人观点,仅供参考 平台声明 该文观点仅代表作者本人,搜狐号系信息发布平台,搜狐仅提供信息存储空间服务。 内容举报 by Taboolaby Taboola Sponsored LinksSponsored Links Promoted LinksPromoted Links 你可能会喜欢 A Christmas Train Display Everyone Will Wa。
